sections.title: C01–C03: additive schema и model interfaces
sections.text:
Migration packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_06_000002_add_scan_evidence_and_work.php и SchemaBuilder fresh definitions используют DatabaseConfig::table(), VaulterDatabase connection, IdStrategy::key/reference для всех package PK/FK; tenant FK shape — существующий HostKeyColumns. Runtime features не отключают создание таблиц. Core models используют HasVaulterKeys/ResolvesVaulterConnection, закрытые fillable (ни authority, ни scan verdict/fence нельзя mass-assign), casts int только на PHP64, UTC immutable datetime. Ни native enum, ни JSON-only work queue.
| Carrier | Точные поля и ограничения |
|---|---|
| drives | scan_admission_sequence signed BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT0 CHECK>=0, common max9223372036854775807. |
| file_revisions | scan_admission_sequence signed BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT0 CHECK>=0; quarantined_at nullable timestamp. Existing rows0, scan_status/MIME/PK/FK/committed_at/bytes не переписывать. New revision получает ++drive counter сервером в outer tx, COPY/restoreRevision тоже. |
| blobs | quarantined_at nullable timestamp; storage_version nullable varchar255 (только trusted adapter при commit, нельзя брать client ETag). Existing rows NULL; exact immutable CAS key остаётся источником bytes. |
| scan_policy_states | id PK; drive_id FK cascade; tenant_id authoritative; predicate_key varchar80 = global либо profile:<key>; mode varchar16 off/new_content_only/all_content; scanner_key/scanner_version/policy_version varchar64; spec_key char64; config_fingerprint char64; rollout_key nullable varchar64; boundary_sequence nullable signed BIGINT CHECK>=0; activated_at/updated_at timestamp. UNIQUE(drive_id,predicate_key). boundary/rollout once-set immutable, сохраняются при off/all; попытка заменить существующий rollout_key отказ. |
| scan_obligations | id PK; revision_id FK file_revisions cascade; drive_id FK cascade; tenant_id; blob_id nullable FK blobs RESTRICT; scope_key varchar191; content_identity char64; sha256 char64; size_bytes signed BIGINT CHECK>=0; spec_key char64; scanner_key/scanner_version/policy_version varchar64; generation signed BIGINT>=1; attempt signed BIGINT>=0; request_key char36; state varchar16 pending/leased/retry_wait/settled; outcome nullable varchar16 clean/infected/failed; reason nullable varchar32; retryable bool; available_at timestamp; lease_token nullable char36; lease_expires_at nullable timestamp; last_published_at nullable timestamp; created_at/updated_at timestamp. UNIQUE(revision_id,spec_key); INDEX(state,available_at,id), INDEX(state,lease_expires_at,id), INDEX(drive_id,id). leased iff both lease fields present; settled has non-null outcome; non-leased clears lease. No zero/overflow wrap. |
| scan_backfill_runs | id PK; drive_id FK cascade; tenant_id; spec_key char64; request_key char36; target_sequence BIGINT>=0; last_admission_sequence BIGINT>=0 default0; last_revision_id nullable IdStrategy reference shape (NO FK, deleted cursor key retained); state varchar16 pending/completed; created_at/updated_at timestamp. UNIQUE(drive_id,spec_key); INDEX(state,id). target_sequence monotonic, cursor tuple(admission_sequence,revision_id) monotonic. Required policy activation records this durable bounded legacy-discovery obligation in same transaction. |
| scan_requests | id PK; obligation_id FK cascade; request_key char36; generation signed BIGINT>=1; requested_at timestamp; reason varchar191; correlation_id varchar191. UNIQUE(obligation_id,request_key), UNIQUE(obligation_id,generation). Append-only dedup ledger; повтор старого request_key не создаёт generation даже после нового rescan. |
| scan_evidence | id PK; obligation_id FK cascade; request_id FK scan_requests cascade; revision_id FK cascade; drive_id FK cascade; tenant_id; blob_id nullable FK blobs RESTRICT; scope_key varchar191; content_identity/spec_key/sha256 char64; size_bytes BIGINT>=0; scanner_key/scanner_version/policy_version varchar64; generation BIGINT>=1; attempt BIGINT>=1; outcome varchar16 clean/infected/failed; reason nullable varchar32; retryable bool; observed_at timestamp; reused_from_id nullable same-table FK SET NULL; revoked_at nullable timestamp; revocation_reason nullable varchar191. UNIQUE(request_id,attempt); INDEX(revision_id,spec_key,outcome); INDEX(blob_id,outcome). Scan result immutable; only trusted revocation fields mutable. |
content_identity = sha256(canonical sorted UTF8 JSON of blob id, scope_key, disk, storage_key, storage_version, revision sha256/size and manifest identity); spec_key = hash(scanner_key,scanner_version,policy_version), excludes enforcement mode/rollout so pre-cutover clean remains compatible. No cross-tenant authority from either hash. Manifest/chunked revision unsupported in P3 scanner (structured failed/unsupported), never scans only first chunk as whole file. Purge removes revision-owned evidence/requests/work before CAS GC; retention keeps evidence for retained revisions. Infected tombstones not erased while the immutable blob exists.
CHECK for counter type/range: PG/MySQL signed BIGINT + nonnegative checks; SQLite integer affinity CHECK(typeof(column)='integer' AND column>=0), rejects REAL overflow. Migration checks actual MySQL enforced CHECK support and strict numeric overflow, unsupported engine fails closed. Down removes added FKs/tables in dependency order, blob/revision/drive added fields, preserves previous data; cannot run down while jobs active. Fresh/up/down/data/custom-prefix and bigint/ulid/uuid7 package keys qualify on all three DBs in owned fixtures; no edits to applied P2 migrations.
Core Content/ScanEvidence final readonly value from persisted record, Models/Content/{ScanObligation,ScanRequest,ScanEvidenceRecord,ScanPolicyState,ScanBackfillRun}; model aliases vaulter.models.{scan_obligation,scan_request,scan_evidence,scan_policy_state,scan_backfill_run}, validate subclass in ConfigValidator. FileRevision gets scanEvidence():HasMany and scanObligations():HasMany using configured classes; evidence value is not an Eloquent model alias.
Core Repositories/Content/ScanObligationRepository internal methods: ensure(FileRevision $revision, ScanPolicySpec $spec, string $requestKey, OperationContext $context):ScanObligation; requestRescan(...same args...):ScanObligation; claim(int|string $id,int $generation,DateTimeImmutable $now):?ScanAttempt; settle(ScanAttempt $attempt,ScanResult $result):bool. ensure/requestRescan require caller Vaulter transaction; claim/settle own short transactions. ScanEvidenceRepository::compatible(FileRevision $revision,ScanPolicySpec $spec):?ScanEvidence; revoke(int|string $evidenceId,string $reason,OperationContext $context):void, reason nonblank<=191, scoped trusted maintenance only, no public quarantine-release API. PolicyStateRepository::activate(Drive $drive,ScanPolicySpec $spec,?string $rolloutKey,OperationContext $context):ScanPolicyState. All load authoritative drive/file/revision/blob, never passed model attributes. Drive services orchestrate these core repositories without core→drive imports.
ScanRequest/ScanEvidenceRecord use timestamps=false (explicit requested_at/observed_at); policy/work/backfill use explicit created_at/updated_at, no timestamp hooks outside owning tx. blob FK RESTRICT protects retained evidence/work from premature physical CAS prune; deleting revision cascades those rows first. ScanBackfillRun checkpoint keeps deleted key scalars, not a referential cursor that GC could null. Fresh builder integrates own feature-independent definitions/create/drop order before core canonical Schema test. FileRevisionRead/Store and Blob model casts/quarantine writes remain server-built only.
Exact required integer CHECKs apply generation/attempt/admission/size on all engines, enumeration states/outcomes are CHECK-limited to declared values, booleans typed; SQLite signed integers cannot promote sequence/generation to REAL. Nullable outcome/reason constraints enforce clean/infected require reason=NULL and retryable=false, failed requires non-null reason. request/evidence rows timestamp defaults explicit server UTC. Field scan_status remains varchar16 compatibility projection; extended failure reasons live evidence/work reason, not oversized scan_status strings. Scanner work blob reference must be exact single committed blob; unsupported manifests have failed obligation snapshot of manifest identity, cannot be silently treated as clean single blob. For manifest-only legacy revision blob_id=NULL, work/evidence blob_id nullable FK references manifest_blob_id when present; immutable snapshot includes payload kind. Ensure produces failed/unsupported without private byte IO; no stored object at all→failed/unknown. Nullable identity cannot enable clean evidence/reuse/direct signing.
For legacy terminal unsupported/unknown obligations without a single blob, evidence failed identity snapshots retain revision sha/size/manifest id in content_identity, blob reference nullable. They can never pass compatible clean guard (requires committed exact single blob), and PrivateScanReader is never invoked. ScanResult/ScanInput only for supported single-blob scan; recovery attempt counter still real if failed admission was immediately settled by service with attempt1 and request/evidence in owning tx.

sections.title: C01: boot, activation, independent rollout eligibility
sections.text:
Core Enums/Cas/ScanMode string off/new_content_only/all_content и Content/ScanPolicySpec readonly(predicateKey,mode,scannerKey,scannerVersion,policyVersion,rolloutKey); scanner/policy ids ASCII [a-zA-Z0-9._:-]{1,64}. P3.6 extends UploadPolicy constructor ONLY appended optional ?ScanMode $scanMode=null, ?string $scanPolicyVersion=null; existing requireScan named arg unchanged. profile null inherits global mode/version; profile false/off does not subtract global eligibility. Explicit requireScan=true always all_content; true plus explicit off/new_content_only contradictory→boot invalid config. Bool false/null with no mode yields off/inherit as declared; supplied global required=false + mode=all_content valid. Never max(mode) between two boundaries.
Canonical global vaulter.scan: mode=null (normalizes off), required=null (normalizes false), scanner=null (FQCN implements ContentScanner), scanner_key=null, scanner_version=null, policy_version=null (normalizes '1'), rollout_key=null. Compatibility vaulter-drive.uploads.scan.{required,mode,scanner,scanner_key,scanner_version,policy_version,rollout_key} defaults all null and accepted as alias ONLY when canonical value null/unset; both non-null unequal values boot error, equal duplicates accepted. No runtime precedence guess. Core ScanConfig supplies normalized global spec; drive DriveConfig supplies work settings only: queue='default', lease_seconds=120, scanner_timeout_seconds=60, max_attempts=5, publish_cooldown_seconds=30, recovery_batch=100, cleanup_batch=100. Validate positive ints, batch1..1000; scanner deadline<job timeout90<lease120<broker retry_after>=180. Host scanner binding/FQCN/version mismatch or absence for ANY enabled global/profile required/new-content enforcement→ConfigurationException on boot in all env; optional off scanner absent allowed. P3.6 schema-free algebra, P3.7 actual scanner/queue validation; no DB query on core profile boot before migrations.
Profile required condition for revision r = all_content OR (new_content_only AND r.scan_admission_sequence > persisted boundary). Egress requires both global and profile conditions, checks current state/config spec hash per call; any matching predicate requires clean evidence for its exact spec_key. off allows no mandatory condition; infected always denied. Missing rollout state or runtime-vs-persisted config fingerprint mismatch→configuration error/fail closed, never grandfather by first read. Newly provisioned drive persists both policy states with boundary0 before admitting its first revision. Existing enabled drives use bounded explicit activation command, not read-time automatic cutoff. Legacy revision admission0 is eligible for exemption only under stored new-content boundary; timestamps/IDs/client flags play no role.
Activation transaction: exclusive drive tree T, fresh drive row Q; capture current scan_admission_sequence for first new_content_only activation, persist immutable rollout_key+boundary and both selected policy specs atomically for that drive. Existing boundary reused on reactivation, cannot reset with a fresh token. Ingest/copy/restoreRevision all hold shared/exclusive T through commit: at Q position after N/F/R validate policy config/spec against persisted state, increment drive counter and assign new revision's admission; then lock and write the exact blob and edge (C) and only after that ensure required obligations and evidence (W). C→W matches I17, settle, requestRescan and backfill. ensure insert-or-select never acquires W before C. CAS, counter and obligation failure roll back the same outer transaction; no Q→N/T and no W→C path. Existing writers excluded from admission during activation by exclusive T; resumed outer retry revalidates spec. Scan counter independent from node.sequence and file.revision_count.
Rollout procedure: migrate additive schema; prepare scanner+versions in off, activate specs, rescan all selected legacy revisions to produce candidate evidence; check counters/status, then set all_content and activate identical scanner/policy versions (mode changes do not invalidate clean). Or explicit new_content_only with nonblank rollout_key, quiesce old unpatched writers, activate each drive under T, then admit patched traffic. During mixed deployment any stale spec mismatch rejects mutations/egress; active requests admitted before cutover are not retroactively interrupted. Never an automatic startup backfill or grandfathering. New scanner/policy version activates a new spec; old evidence fails compatibility immediately, bounded backfill prepares new spec. P7.2 owns production schedules, P8.2 historical-chain upgrade; P3.7 supplies working commands now.
For pre-existing revisions becoming required, activation atomically creates/extends scan_backfill_runs to the captured drive counter for each required spec. Revision egress blocks immediately even before its per-revision work is materialized; durable run represents that legacy-discovery obligation. Reconciler expands missing work boundedly, so no infinite pending gap after interrupted manual backfill. Every NEW required revision still records its own work in creation outer transaction; legacy discovery is not falsely claimed to insert an unbounded drive history atomically.
Appended profile scanPolicyVersion can strengthen with independent spec but cannot remove global required predicate; supplied profile scanner version always same bound scanner. A profile scanMode=off while global all_content still contributes no subtraction. ScanConfig uses null defaults for all canonical/alias policy keys before normalization; canonical non-null vs alias non-null detects explicit conflict. It does not try to infer owner intent from default-populated config-array key presence. Canonical off+scanner null carries internal scanner key/version none only for no-work policy; rescan mode off still requires configured real scanner before creating optional work. Missing scanner optional rescan returns2, no impossible job. Core-only default resolver disabled/off is explicit, profile required=true while drive runtime absent fails before egress, no silently exempt optional package.

sections.title: C03: generation, lease, publication, settle
sections.text:
Initial ensure locks revision under normal family locks, insert-or-select UNIQUE(revision,spec); creates generation1/attempt0/pending, request row. Same outer rollback removes both revision and intent; compatible clean reuse creates own target obligation+request+evidence and settled/clean atomically. afterCommit on Vaulter connection OUTERMOST commit only publishes (id,generation); catches broker exception into safe diagnostic, leaves pending. No webhook OutboxRelay/feature dependency, no pre-commit queue job. Every required admission has durable own obligation even reused clean; optional off content need not have work until explicit rescan.
| Trigger | Locked transition and fence |
|---|---|
| claim due pending/retry_wait or expired leased | W-only short transaction; re-fetch generation, due time/state, increment attempt, fresh server UUID lease_token + expiresAt, leased; duplicate active lease→null. attempt<=5. Commit before IO. |
| explicit requestRescan | T/N/F/R/C→W; new UNIQUE request_key ledger allocates generation+1, attempt0/pending, clears old lease; unchanged old request_key is no-op regardless intervening requests. New epoch creates separate spec obligation. Overflow→deterministic exception+rollback. Old queued gen loses. |
| clean/infected result | short settle T(shared)→N→F→R→C→W; validate existing exact revision→file→node→drive/tenant, blob/edge committed immutable identity, spec, generation/attempt/token and lease still live; append result evidence UNIQUE(request,attempt), settled/outcome; duplicate settlement returns false. No update WHERE file_id of head. |
| transient failed | same fence; append failed evidence, reason scanner_timeout/scanner_unavailable/transient_io, retryable=true; attempt<5→retry_wait + next time, clears lease; otherwise settled/failed reason attempts_exhausted, preserves prior evidence. Backoff after attempts1..4:30,120,600,1800 seconds from DB clock. |
| deterministic unavailable | unsupported/too_large/password_protected/access_denied/unknown/content_identity_mismatch→failed evidence, retryable=false, settled/failed; unclassified exception→unknown not clean. Explicit rescan after remediation creates new generation. |
| expired lease at attempt5 | recovery sets settled/failed attempts_exhausted with fenced failed evidence; never forever leased. No auto infinite retries, doctor/operator sees terminal failure. |
| deleted revision | FK cascade has removed work; claim/read/settle returns no-op with safe reason, no resurrect/repoint. wrong scope/identity before bytes fails job without retry; row not settled as clean, no foreign mutation. |
ScanAttempt readonly snapshots obligation/revision/blob/drive/tenant/contentIdentity/spec/generation/attempt/token/deadline. Job payload ONLY obligation_id+generation+drive_id+tenant_id (no raw storage key/user/system flag); authoritative row loaded before scope checks. Job has framework tries=1: SQL work scheduler owns retries, broker redelivery still allowed. Host tenancy middleware restores first; Vaulter validates second (P3.8). Configuration/version mismatch blocks read/claim processing until deployment fixed, not silent old-spec scan. Scanner IO outside SQL transaction, within60s deadline. Job timeout90, lease120, retry_after>=180; bounded timeout/kill tests require owning worker process to terminate, no promise that generic PHP interface can interrupt malicious host code.
Public ContentAvailabilityGuard precedence after locator/actor/ACL/profile: authoritative legacy scan_status=infected OR revision/blob quarantined_at OR unrevoked infected evidence for exact scoped bytes→423; any required predicate without compatible unrevoked clean→423; otherwise allowed. Work failed/pending never produces clean. scan_status retained projection: infected priority, then current-compatible clean, then live pending, then failed, else not_required. Thus optional failed rescan leaves projection clean when valid evidence exists; work failure remains visible separately. Bare legacy clean string without versioned evidence is not required-mode proof. clean/infected terminal per attempt only. Infected sets revision AND immutable blob quarantine in same settle; later clean, same SHA reupload, COPY, restore or rescan never clears it. No P3 release-quarantine workflow; future explicit authorized audit workflow required, not a late worker or config off.
Expiry exhaustion is a recovery CAS under the authoritative scoped W row, writes failed evidence using its immutable snapshot; it never uses normal clean settle with an expired token and never changes blob/head. Scan job clean settlement requires live lease; rejected callback is no-op. Scope-validation job failure leaves work diagnostically stalled/terminal failed under correct maintenance recovery, never retries into a different tenant.
Obsolete spec recovery: AFTER active policy activation has committed new required backfill intent, reconcile recognizes obligation.spec_key absent from current global/profile specs (off specs included), scoped W CAS leased/pending/retry_wait→settled/failed reason=superseded_policy/retryable=false and clears token. Stale worker then cannot settle, no clean/evidence or head change from invalid engine version. Old retained compatible evidence remains forensic and can qualify only if exact same spec later explicitly configured; sticky infection unaffected. Running settle also validates spec is current before result append; mode change with same spec does not obsolete evidence. Missing/mismatched deployment config without a completed new activation is stalled_configuration, not prematurely superseded.
Legacy infection cannot launder before evidence backfill: availability/admission/reuse query authoritative existing revision scan_status=infected through exact blob_id or file_revision_blobs edge for the selected physical blob and persisted scope, even when quarantined_at/evidence still NULL. Never search another tenant by digest as authority. Matching legacy infection denies public bytes/new admission and clean reuse; trusted maintenance may stamp sticky blob/revision quarantine at detection. Historical rows/timestamps/scan_status remain unchanged in migration, no fabricated clean verdict. Same immutable blob infection can deny reupload of those bytes; no public disclosure of the other revision/tenant id. SEC-R06 and infected reupload fixture include legacy infected/no evidence case.

sections.title: C02: evidence compatibility, COPY/restore, revocation
sections.text:
Core Contracts/Cas/ContentScanner methods key():string, version():string, scan(ScanInput $input):ScanResult; key/version must exactly equal configured scanner identity on boot and immediately before IO. ScanInput readonly(stream, revisionId, blobId, driveId, tenantId, scopeKey, sha256, size, detectedMime, scannerVersion, policyVersion, DateTimeImmutable deadline); stream is owned by service, scanner borrows and cannot convert all bytes to a string. ScanResult readonly(ScanVerdict $verdict,?string $reason=null,bool $retryable=false); ScanVerdict enum Clean='clean',Infected='infected',Failed='failed'. Clean/Infected with reason/retryable contradictory reject; failed reason from closed taxonomy in StateMachine. No raw engine signatures/paths in public payload. Fake fixtures read actual immutable bytes, bounded chunks, return structured results; external AV setup stays host-owned.
Drive Content/PrivateScanReader::open(ScanAttempt $attempt):mixed (@return resource|null) internally reloads authoritative work and current live lease, revision/file/node/drive/tenant, blob scope/disk/storage key and edge/size/digest before BlobStore::read. No scalar public capability constructor, no Request flag, no extension asSystem shortcut. Capability created by claim, consumed only by ScanFileRevision in same trusted integration. Read can access quarantined bytes and ignores public Download feature/availability, never bypasses tenant or exact attempt fence. Job finally closes stream on success/throw/timeout process teardown; framework middleware cannot mint URL. Core cannot import this drive service. Host PHP is trusted, raw BlobStore/StorageDriver is storage API, not an application authorization boundary.
compatible evidence requires persisted revision/blob/edge identity, same drive+tenant+scope (P3 permits reuse ONLY same drive), sha256+size exact, spec_key exact scanner+policy version, clean outcome, no revoked_at, no revision/blob quarantine or scoped infected evidence. No sharing by digest across drives/tenants. Evidence new spec not inferred compatible by version ordering, no automatic age-expiry in P3; revoked row unavailable immediately, later new evidence may requalify only if no sticky infection. Revoke reason/context audit via existing identity plumbing, no false P5 durable guarantee.
COPY preflights subtree support and source availability under source policy; infected source refuses before target writes. Copies retained immutable revisions/edges, calculates own admission sequence for every new revision, evaluates destination policy and ensures own obligation. Legacy exemption/not_required/string clean/work lease never copied. If same-drive compatible clean permitted, insert target evidence with reused_from_id and target identity; own obligation settled/clean, no network/job; off source pending/failed→required target pending/own job. Cross-drive COPY remains whatever current API permits, but evidence cannot reuse. restoreRevision creates new revision/head with same destination policy and fresh admission; historical clean reusable under exact identity/version/scope, infected source refuses. Trash restore retains revision/admission identity, rechecks current policy; can restore metadata while bytes blocked, recovery/backfill supplies missing work. Reading explicit older clean revision allowed when that exact evidence qualifies; head read never substitutes old clean revision. Work/evidence changes do not bump node.sequence, quota, head or revision allocation number.
Exact internal readonly value constructors in core Content (resource parameters use mixed + @param resource):
ScanInput::__construct(public mixed $stream, public int|string $revisionId, public int|string $blobId, public int|string $driveId, public int|string|null $tenantId, public string $scopeKey, public string $sha256, public int $size, public ?string $detectedMime, public string $scannerVersion, public string $policyVersion, public DateTimeImmutable $deadline).
ScanResult::__construct(public ScanVerdict $verdict, public ?string $reason=null, public bool $retryable=false).
ScanAttempt::__construct(public int|string $obligationId, public int|string $revisionId, public int|string|null $blobId, public int|string $driveId, public int|string|null $tenantId, public string $contentIdentity, public ScanPolicySpec $spec, public int $generation, public int $attempt, public string $leaseToken, public DateTimeImmutable $leaseExpiresAt, public DateTimeImmutable $deadline).
ScanPolicySpec::__construct(public string $predicateKey, public ScanMode $mode, public string $scannerKey, public string $scannerVersion, public string $policyVersion, public ?string $rolloutKey=null); specKey():string/configFingerprint():string canonical sorted JSON, validate prescribed strings. Off without scanner uses key/version='none' and no scan IO.
ContentAvailabilityGuard::assertAvailable(OperationContext $context,Node $node,FileRevision $revision):void and assertAvailableForShare(ShareContext $context,Node $node,FileRevision $revision):void; core Contracts/Content/ScanPolicyResolver::forDrive(Drive $drive):array (list<ScanPolicySpec>), ::required(FileRevision $revision,ScanPolicySpec $spec):bool; core no-drive default resolver exposes only off, an enabled global/profile spec without required drive runtime binding fails boot (not silently off). Drive Content/ScanPolicyResolver binds after drive installed. Guard re-fetches keys and derived ShareContext scope, selection does not mint private capability.
ScanEvidence::__construct(public int|string $id, public int|string $revisionId, public int|string|null $blobId, public int|string $driveId, public int|string|null $tenantId, public string $scopeKey, public string $contentIdentity, public string $specKey, public ScanVerdict $verdict, public ?DateTimeImmutable $revokedAt, public DateTimeImmutable $observedAt). Reuse method internal ScanEvidenceRepository::reuse(FileRevision $target,ScanEvidence $source,ScanPolicySpec $spec,ScanObligation $obligation):ScanEvidence requires locked tx and revalidates persisted source, never trusts supplied value.
ImmutableContentIdentity::__construct(public int|string $blobId,public string $scopeKey,public string $disk,public string $storageKey,public ?string $storageVersion,public string $sha256,public int $size); fingerprint():string canonical JSON. SignedContentUrl::__construct(public string $url,public DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt,public string $contentIdentity,public ?string $storageVersion); service validates expiry and signer immutable-key guarantee, URL object alone is not authority.
Internal repository ensure/requestRescan explicit full signature: (FileRevision $revision,ScanPolicySpec $spec,string $requestKey,OperationContext $context):ScanObligation. Existing body stores generation/request dedup, not a caller-chosen attempt. All aliased models configured from core VaulterConfig::model, resolved connection from core DatabaseConfig; strict context semantics wired by P3.8. Public header/value payload avoids reason detail that would reveal protected scanner/filesystem data.

Structured failed reasons enum closed set includes scanner_timeout/scanner_unavailable/transient_io/unsupported/too_large/password_protected/access_denied/unknown/content_identity_mismatch/attempts_exhausted/superseded_policy; only first three auto retry. Source selection/file scope errors are concealed or safe internal failure before result insertion, not clean. ScanAttempt and ScanEvidence constructors take int|string|null $blobId, null only for an already-terminal unsupported/unknown manifest with no single committed blob. Clean and infected reject null. ScanInput and ImmutableContentIdentity keep int|string $blobId and are never built from a null blob. PrivateScanReader is not called for that row. No no-scan clean result from interface type coercion.
Legacy infection cannot launder before evidence backfill: availability/admission/reuse query authoritative existing revision scan_status=infected through exact blob_id or file_revision_blobs edge for the selected physical blob and persisted scope, even when quarantined_at/evidence still NULL. Never search another tenant by digest as authority. Matching legacy infection denies public bytes/new admission and clean reuse; trusted maintenance may stamp sticky blob/revision quarantine at detection. Historical rows/timestamps/scan_status remain unchanged in migration, no fabricated clean verdict. Same immutable blob infection can deny reupload of those bytes; no public disclosure of the other revision/tenant id. SEC-R06 and infected reupload fixture include legacy infected/no evidence case.

sections.title: C03/C09: exact commands, bounded rescan/reconcile/cleanup
sections.text:
Commands are package Console owners registered by drive Providers/ConsoleRegistrar. Signatures (all ids opaque package int|string, scopes authenticated maintenance, no external cloud commands):
vaulter:scan-reconcile {--tenant=} {--drive=} {--all-tenants} {--reason=} {--limit=100} {--max-seconds=30} {--dry-run} {--json}
vaulter:scan-rescan {--tenant=} {--drive=} {--all-tenants} {--reason=} {--revision=*} {--after=} {--limit=100} {--request-id=} {--rescan} {--retry-failed} {--activate-policy} {--dry-run} {--json}
Enabled tenancy requires --tenant or explicit --all-tenants + reason; contradictory scopes error before SQL; drive must belong to selected tenant, --revision belongs to selected drive(s). --all-tenants uses bounded scoped withoutTenancy wrapper + system reason, derives scope from every persisted drive; P3.8 forbids passing bypass to queued scanner. reason nonblank<=191 for mutating operations; default reason vaulter:scan-reconcile only for single selected tenant; global all-tenants never defaults. limit1..1000, max-seconds1..60. Invalid flags/cursor return2 no changes; unexpected scope corruption fail1 with safe summary; success0 means scheduled/processed intents, not all clean. --rescan/--retry-failed mutually exclusive; --activate-policy forbids --revision and --rescan/--retry-failed (separate bounded drive activation). --dry-run writes nothing, publishes nothing, prints predicted counts only.
rescan without --activate-policy selects revisions by drive_id,scan_admission_sequence,id ASC (DB key type order) and exact current specs even mode off; missing work→ensure; existing valid clean→skip; nonterminal→reuse; terminal fail→skip unless --retry-failed; --rescan explicitly new request generation for every selected spec even clean. Missing request-id generates UUID once and prints it; resumed --after must retain printed request-id. Cursor is HMAC-signed JSON{version,request_id,mode,tenant,drive,filters,spec_keys,last_drive_id,last_revision_id}; reject altered scope/spec/flags with2. Request dedup ledger makes retry of page idempotent. --activate-policy pages drive_id with same signed shape and captures boundary under T; idempotent repeat existing rollout boundary. Inserts own obligations+requests under each revision family locks, safe no head/quota changes. Output JSON schema: version1, command, request_id, scanned, activated, created, reused, skipped, failed, published, cleanup_completed, next_cursor|null, elapsed_ms, dry_run. Counts explicit nonnegative; no tokens/URLs/storage paths/foreign ids in diagnostics. Tests inspect durable row counts, not CLI exit only.
reconcile one pass selects <=limit due W ids using indexes, canonical available_at,id ASC, short row claim/expired-lease reset CAS; no W lock held when acquiring T/N. Expired attempts<5→retry_wait due now, clears lease/fences old token; expired5→settled failed. Pending/retry_wait publication after own committed update, every cooldown30s until actual worker claims; last_published_at is scheduling hint, never terminal/dispatched. Publish failure leaves due intent; lost ACK/redelivery safe by claim fencing. A continually failing row gets available_at cooldown to avoid starving other rows; no unbounded while loop, stop at count/time bound and report remaining_due. terminal failures stay visible until explicit rescan, not erased by scheduler. No scan obligation pruned while revision exists.
Same command independently reclaims <=cleanup_batch committed upload_sessions with cleanup_pending=true, due cleanup_available_at, session mutex; deletes only exact session-owned staging parts+assembled file, sets cleanup false after success in new transaction. Failure leaves flag, retries30/120/600/1800 then daily cap3600 seconds (cleanup never silently abandoned), increments cleanup_attempts, safe reason. Sessions marked committed are never re-ingested. Probe loops obey max-seconds even under failure. dry-run covers cleanup too.
Minimal host schedule in UPGRADE docs (P3.7 executable now): Schedule::command('vaulter:scan-reconcile --all-tenants --reason=scheduled-scan-recovery --limit=100 --max-seconds=30')->everyMinute()->withoutOverlapping(2); DB CAS remains multi-scheduler guard (cache lock not authority). Disabled-tenancy standalone omit --all-tenants and use explicit system reason. Bootstrap activation/backfill invoked intentionally, no periodic --rescan all clean policy. P7.1 doctor/P7.2 production orchestration/P7.4 host fixtures/P7.6 docs remain mandatory; P3 supplies functioning baseline and queue middleware ordering.
ScanBackfillReconciler::expand(int $limit=100,int $maxSeconds=30):array selects pending runs without holding run lock, then revisions ordered by (scan_admission_sequence,id) within drive and <=target_sequence. For each revision: take normal T/N/F/R/C family locks, ensure missing work with stable run request_key, then lock run last and CAS its original cursor tuple→processed tuple in SAME transaction. Competing cursor CAS loser rolls back its redundant materialization and reloads; no run-lock→T path. Compatible evidence may settle work, existing work reused, never force rescan generation. Deleted selected revision safely advances tuple. Reaches snapshot end→completed; activation that extends target reopens completed cursor without resetting admission boundary or old request ledger. New admissions >old target cannot fall below cursor regardless UUID/ULID order. Run lease is unnecessary: transaction CAS/unique work plus repeated scheduler recovers crash; no IO while locked. Reconcile includes <=limit expansion and <=limit work publications and <=cleanup_batch cleanup, all within max-seconds admission budget; time limit checked between units, a single bounded DB call cannot be preempted and timeout is governed by DB statement/lock timeout. Counts JSON adds backfill_materialized, backfill_remaining; no assertion that limit is hard wall-clock cancellation. --after CLI rescan cursor also uses admission_sequence,id within each drive, never bare UUID monotonicity. Scope/spec change rejects prior cursor; explicit activation state desired-spec fingerprint includes rollout key and mode. Three loops are finite, not while pending until empty.

Config version mismatch: reconciler keeps intents due but emits stalled_configuration count, no private reads/settle clean; operator deploys compatible versions then reactivates/restarts. Explicit rescan of old desired spec requires currently bound matching scanner, no processing obsolete version by newer scanner. After committed replacement policy activation legacy inactive-spec work terminates as superseded_policy via StateMachine CAS, not forever stalled work. Missing mismatched deployment config remains diagnostically stalled until activation/repair; no bytes read or fake clean. Native CLI supplies proper configured tenant middleware restoration before dispatch; scanner worker never calls withoutTenancy.
Exact drive service entrypoints: ScanWorkReconciler::reconcile(int $limit=100,int $maxSeconds=30,bool $dryRun=false):array; ScanBackfillReconciler::expand(int $limit=100,int $maxSeconds=30):array; UploadCleanupReconciler::reconcile(int $limit=100,int $maxSeconds=30,bool $dryRun=false):array. Commands validate scope/flags then invoke services with bounded selected drive context; returned summaries conform prescribed JSON counters, not arbitrary container callbacks. No command executes scanner synchronously; dispatcher only publishes scoped jobs after commit.
--request-id accepts canonical UUIDv4 (lowercase normalized from valid UUIDv4 string); malformed/nil/other opaque text return2 before SQL. --after requires HMAC signature and same stable request-id/spec/scope; --revision keys resolved in selected drive, not used to derive tenant privilege. Initial run request-id generated server-side UUIDv4; no admission boundary from that timestamp.

sections.title: C04: guard taxonomy and feature matrix
sections.text:
P3.1 introduces core Enums/Operations/OperationKind Metadata/Mutation/ContentEgress/Purge; OperationGuard::authorize(OperationContext $context, Ability $ability, Node $node, OperationKind $operation=OperationKind::Metadata):void; authorizeCreate(OperationContext $context,Node $parent):void. Actor resolves first (missing401), locator/persisted drive+tenant (foreign404), user View (hidden404), user ability (403), effective profile operation gate (403), data invariants; system bypasses ONLY two ACL checks. Scanner claim/read uses its private service, never public OperationKind parameter as a capability.
| Operation | User ACL | Relevant feature/policy | Scan/public availability | Scope/locks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Metadata/list/abilities/history/handler descriptor | View + named ability where norm asks | listing/type/read policy; no upload/download requirement invented | metadata without bytes/URL remains visible even quarantine | persisted drive/tenant, fresh ACL each call |
| create/ingest/addRevision/restoreRevision | Create destination, Edit target as applicable | upload size/MIME/extension; resumable enabled only protocol initiate/patch/complete | destination admission; infected content cannot launder | T/N/F/R/Q/C + expectation |
| rename/update/move/trash/trash restore | Edit/Move/Trash/Restore + actual destination Create | operation policy; neither scan engine health nor upload MIME gates deletion/rename | no bytes; trash restore reevaluates current policy on later egress | fresh under family locks |
| grant/share/comment | View + Share/Comment/Manage | grants/share_links/comments AND global/profile | mint metadata token has no clean promise, each later download gate | target membership, no foreign rows |
| file read/download/preview/thumbnail/export bytes | View + Download (Copy uses Copy on source) or scoped share credential | profile/content egress policy, sharing flags for share lane | exact revision compatible clean if eligible, infected always denied | before bytes/URL/304, stream close finally |
| private scanner | authoritative claim capability, not user/system Download | configured scanner + matching spec/attempt; ignores public egress restrictions | can read exact quarantined immutable revision | tenant/job validated before bytes; IO outside tx |
| purge/trash empty/GC/sweep/reconcile | Delete for public purge; explicit system for maintenance | retention/eligibility/CAS safety; NO upload/resumable/download/scan-required feature gate | infected cleanup allowed, no egress | tenant or narrow maintenance bypass + T/N/F/R/Q/C, no public bypass |
Existing profile public API has no download(bool)/uploadsEnabled(bool) setter; this design does not invent one. Contract's download restriction is ACL Download/current effective egress policy; profile UploadPolicy gates admission, not purge. shareLinks(false), comments(false), grants(false), configured resumable=false have concrete gates above. System+profile share disabled stays403; system infected public stream423; system foreign drive404. ProfileGuardBoundaryTest tests all four guard surfaces including authorizeCreate/visible/abilities; inactive features narrow capability projection, no ACL-derived cross-request cache. P3.6 real wiring, P3.8 current tenant/private capability integration.

sections.title: C08: installed egress inventory and strict/direct semantics
sections.text:
Static inventory as of this supplemental design, not a runtime audit. Existing product downloads already mediated, no discovered production temporaryUrl() caller. StorageDriver/FlysystemStorageDriver implement capability only. P3.7 changes these exact installed boundaries:
| File / symbol | Bytes/capability and P3 action | Named proof |
|---|---|---|
| drive Http/Controllers/DownloadController::{current,version,streamFromDisk} | head/explicit revision via files()->read, fresh guard before response, finally closes actual stream on read error/disconnect; committed Blob check | ContentDeliveryBoundaryTest: identity head, explicit old clean, pending head, stream close |
| core Http/Controllers/Sharing/PublicShareController::{download,stream,streamFromDisk} + Sharing/ShareResolver + Middleware/ResolveShareToken | token hash/TTL/password/max_uses/scope fresh; derive own drive tenant, View+Download bit; scan before byte open, no ambient user/system substitution; re-fetch share at read start | PublicShareDownloadHeadersTest, ContentDeliveryBoundaryTest shared revoke/pending |
| core Handlers/{FileDescriptorFactory,NodePresenter,FileHandlerRegistry,Builtin/PreviewHandler} + Http/Resources/Drive/NodeResource | metadata capabilities/UI only, no bytes/URL; cached descriptor never grants egress. PreviewHandler currently advertises preview/thumbnail, contains no derivative byte writer/route | descriptor reuse revoked/scan changed; non-egress metadata stays View-scoped |
| documents Export/NodeExportService::{export,contentOf} + Http/Controllers/Documents/DocumentNodeController::{show,revision,handler,export} + Http/Resources/DocumentRevisionResource | existing exports/read are inline DocumentContent (not FileRevision CAS); fresh context/View+Download for content/export, no fabricated file scan evidence for inline document. Attached CAS FileRevision source, if any, goes through same core availability gate. Only actual head selected, no cache substituted old content | documents ContentEgressBoundaryTest + existing ExporterContentGuardTest/DocumentContentReadPathTest |
| documents Engines/Handlers/{TipTapHandler,UniverHandler} | descriptors only; trusted external host rendering cannot mint raw storage URL via descriptor. New exporters/lifecycle scans P4.4 owner | descriptor inventory and handler contracts |
| drive Operations/FileOperations::read (created P3.3) | new PHP entry delegates fresh content service, returns exact FileStream, never URL | core Content/EgressInventoryTest + drive ContentDeliveryBoundaryTest |
| media Cas/{BlobStore::read,FlysystemStorageDriver::{get,temporaryUrl}} and core Contracts/Cas/{BlobStore,StorageDriver} | trusted raw storage seams, not public auth API; product egress cannot call temporaryUrl directly; P3.7 arch assertions for installed HTTP/handlers/export paths | strict URL spy get-only, no calls temporaryUrl |
| filament Resources/NodeResource + actions, core SharedNodeResource, drive UploadSessionResource | metadata and operations; bytes only through declared mediated route; result pointers do not reveal raw blob/storage keys | metadata/no URL+parity fixtures |
There is currently no installed preview/thumbnail derivative byte cache or conditional304 branch in these controllers. EgressInventoryTest asserts this fact over declarations/callers and checks descriptors are authority-free; do not invent a successful revoke-cache test over a nonexistent endpoint. Available protected HTTP responses set Cache-Control: private, no-store; no conditional304 added in P3. If host introduces derivative cache it must store exact source revision identity and re-enter live guard for each serve; future concrete P4.4/P6.1/P6.3 contracts require actual cache/304 proof. Inline documents are already guarded egress but full versioned immutable document availability/scanning belongs P4 lifecycle, not fake status on DocumentRevision.
Core Content/ContentDelivery owns stream(OperationContext,Node,FileRevision):FileStream, streamForShare(ShareContext,Node,FileRevision):FileStream and directUrl(OperationContext,Node,FileRevision,int $ttlSeconds):SignedContentUrl. Reload key only, authoritative file/node/drive/blob/edge; exact generation/version selection then auth/profile/scan check immediately before raw read/sign. Public share remains mediated even when direct opt-in enabled; no new route/JSON URL field in P3. FileStream signature unchanged. Strong ETag full-dependency choice remains P6, bare sequence never advertised sufficient; no hidden→304.
Core vaulter.downloads.delivery_mode='strict' default; enum strict/direct_signed, direct_ttl_seconds=60, maximum300. Explicit direct_signed requires bound Contracts/Cas/DirectContentUrlSigner with sign(ImmutableContentIdentity $content,DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt):SignedContentUrl; require exact trusted storage_version OR immutable write-once key guarantee stated by adapter, actual signer expiresAt<=now+300 and identity==selected object. No compatible signer→boot config error; unsupported adapter→explicit failure before raw temporaryUrl, no fallback. SignedContentUrl readonly(url,expiresAt,contentIdentity,storageVersion); constructors reject arbitrary expiry, service checks returned identity/time. No URLs in descriptors/activity/logs/evidence. Lower configured TTL1..300 valid; requested ttl above configured max rejected, no silent provider extension.
Strict mode directUrl fails ProfileRestriction before signer; direct mode fresh sign request rechecks same ACL/scan and is intentionally a bounded bearer capability. App revoke/quarantine blocks next gateway/sign request; issued direct URL remains until expiry/storage-policy deny, already started stream may continue. Trusted IAM/TBAC optional adapter with separate update protocol, not core default guarantee. Tests fake signer exact object/expiry and app revoke semantics, not real cloud revocation. P4.4 exporters and P6.1/P6.3 HTTP/client caching/ETag/If-Match stay assigned by correction contract.

sections.title: C07: signed BIGINT, helper algorithm, participating writer map
sections.text:
P3.3 migration 2026_10_06_000001_add_node_operation_sequence.php and fresh SchemaBuilder define nodes.sequence signed BIGINT default0; no historical applied migration rewrite. Common domain0..9223372036854775807 irrespective package ID type. PG/MySQL CHECK>=0, SQLite CHECK(typeof(sequence)='integer' AND sequence>=0); max overflow deterministic helper exception SequenceOverflowException code node_sequence_exhausted HTTP409; invalid expectation negative/non-int→InvalidArgumentException before side effects. PHP_INT_SIZE must8 when sequence APIs boot; no float casts. Model cast integer, not fillable. P6 decimal string precision handling separate owner.
Core Operations/NodeSequence::assertExpected(Node $locked,?int $expected):void; bump(Node $locked):int; assert requires Vaulter transaction and scoped fresh locked node (locator attributes ignored), mismatch StaleNodeException node_sequence_mismatch412. bump explicitly errors at max before increment; conditional UPDATE WHERE id/drive/sequence=current enforces one row, no wrap/saturation; transaction rollback if not exactly1. Actions call helper ONCE per changed aggregate at end, not automatic Eloquent observer/Repository bump; low-level NodeStore is internal trusted persistence, not second API. Effective no-op checks expected before returning; skips UPDATE/event/quota/work. Any new revision/head identity changes aggregate even when digest equal. Deadlock/serialization retry retains original expected/options and prepared bytes, re-fetches current locked row, never substitutes fresh sequence into expected.
| Current writer/callsite | Participation owned P3.3 (P3.7 later admission integration) |
|---|---|
| drive Actions/Nodes/{RenameNodeAction,MoveNodeAction,new UpdateNodeAction} | +1 changed name/parent/pinned/position only; same effective values no-op+expectation check; source and chosen destination invariants under T/N. |
| drive Actions/Nodes/CreateFolderAction, IngestFileAction::commitNewFile, CopyNodeAction::{copyNode,copyFilePayload}, DriveProvisioner root | new nodes0, initial head+metadata stamping does not bump; COPY source unchanged. |
| drive Actions/Files/IngestFileAction::{commitNewVersion,executeUpload}, new RestoreFileRevisionAction, Content/FileContentLifecycle | existing head change+size/MIME facts one +1, expected before revision/quota/CAS/work; copied new heads node0. |
| drive Actions/Trash/{TrashNodeAction,RestoreNodeAction} + NodeStoreRepository::{trashSubtree,restoreSubtree} | root expectation under exclusive T then sorted N, every actual changed descendant +1 once; restore move+flags count one logical mutation, stale root rejects entire subtree; compare root is not descendant snapshot token. |
| drive Actions/Trash/PurgeNodeAction, Console/PurgeTrashCommand, TrashOperations::{purge,empty} | expectation on root before deletions/edges/quota; no bump deleted nodes; each root atomic with partial-root behavior already contracted. |
| documents Actions/Documents/{CreateDocumentAction,UpdateDocumentContentAction} | create0; both debounce overwrite and append/head branches locked N, compare actual protected content+head+metadata; changed existing aggregate+1, identical no-op0. |
| documents Actions/Revisions/{CreateNamedRevisionAction,RestoreDocumentRevisionAction} | creates/repoints existing head→+1 once even same content, restore source/destination scoped; all events after same tx. |
| documents Actions/Collaboration/PersistCollaborationStateAction | ACTUAL installed Yjs writer: lock N; both in-place debounce and append/head branches +1 if persisted yjs/projection/head changes, identical effective state no-op; awareness/token/session rows do not bump. Future new Document/Yjs API writers P4.7 consume helper. |
| core NodeStoreRepository::{update,repointHead,rename,move,trashSubtree,restoreSubtree} | write primitives require current action family locks; no independent sequence increment, protected current_version_id/file_id pointer changes occur in one owning action; repository tests do not fake public bypass guarantee. |
| core FileRevisionStoreRepository retention/prune; documents UpdateRevisionRetentionAction/DocumentRevisionStoreRepository::prune | history-only keep/prune without live head mutation no editorial bump; own history dependency/ETag P6. ACL/share/scan/driver/profile/activity/outbox unaffected editorial counter. |
Current Document data inputs gain appended optional expectedSequence only where already exposed by P3 caller map; hub webhook current signature need not gain public If-Match yet, still increments under lock. No new Documents aggregate, callbacks or endpoint redesign in P3.3. Root/subtree expectation protects root; atomic multi-node future API would need explicit map of expectations; current single-root APIs take locks and never claim snapshot proof. No automatic parent bump for child insertion/move; children-list version separate.
Committed upload replay BEFORE expectation comparison after current actor/session-owner/tenant/result View and required mutation ability validation + exact payload identity check. Result pointers node/revision/blob must still agree, returned node can have changed sequence; no new event/bump/work. Same request key + different canonical payload digest→UploadConflictException; missing/deleted result404, corrupt pointers409, never repeat ingestion. Original expectation is part of persisted canonical input identity, not re-compared to live sequence on replay. Copy has no public idempotency key in CopyOptions, so each successful new copy is new command/node, no fictitious dedup promise.
Legacy Document/Yjs vs rename actual PG interleaving carrier is documents tests/Document/LegacyNodeSequenceRaceTest.php (P3.3/V11, phase/V930); serial owner assertions in LegacyNodeSequenceTest.php. Root expected match + concurrent child state is not treated as snapshot guarantee.
Current UpdateDocumentContentInput gets appended public ?int $expectedSequence=null after actorId; UpdateDocumentContentAction compares it under locked authoritative Node before deciding overwrite/append/no-op. Existing hub PersistCollaborationStateInput signature stays intact, bump is mandatory even without client expectation; PG legacy race uses actual Yjs writer with existing unconditional PHP command vs rename supplied expectation, plus two expected7 Document-vs-rename to demonstrate mutual CAS participants. Missing expectation consciously last-writer-wins, never fabricated 412 for unconditional Yjs. Existing document restore/named actions accept appended ?int $expectedSequence=null after existing args where callable PHP paths need CAS; these minimal signature additions do not expose new endpoint preconditions/Document Operations. Public critical REST If-Match remains P6.

sections.title: C03: resource ownership and outer commit cleanup
sections.text:
Extend upload_sessions add result_blob_id nullable IdStrategy FK reference; input_fingerprint nullable char64; cleanup_pending bool defaultfalse; cleanup_attempts integer default0>=0; cleanup_available_at nullable timestamp; cleanup_last_reason nullable varchar32; INDEX(status,cleanup_pending,cleanup_available_at,id). Existing result_node_id/result_revision_id/assembled_blob_id reused, not added twice. Legacy committed pointers backfill ONLY if persisted identities provably resolve same node/revision/blob; otherwise explicit UploadConflictException/recovery diagnostic, no guessed head. Schema fixture checks additive migration and old rows. cleanup pending can preserve committed staged bytes until recovered, never authority to create revision.
CompleteUploadAction resource-owner try/finally starts immediately after first staged read acquisition; MIME sniff+inspection are inside it, sniff stream has its own nested finally. PreparedUpload owns temp and its open streams, borrowed caller resource/PSR never closes. Source staging once outside retry, SQL retry reuses immutable prepared bytes; complete keeps existing session mutex through outer transaction, sweeper/abort cannot delete mid-read. Server input_fingerprint = hash(protocol upload id, actor ref/session owner, drive/tenant, target node/parent, normalized filename/options including original expectation, actual sha/size/detected MIME); ignored client correlation changes do not alter identity. Client supplied blob/url/type/id cannot fill pointers.
Same Vaulter OUTER transaction commits node/revision/head, CAS edge+quota, own scan obligation/request, session status=committed/result node/revision/blob/input_fingerprint and cleanup_pending=true/cleanup_available_at=now. markCommitted CAS requires authoritative Assembled session, all pointer relationships verified. CompleteUploadAction's nested transaction return is never cleanup permission. VaulterDatabase::afterCommit registers cleanup callback on actual outermost connection. Callback reloads committed session + mutex and exact staging owner key, deletes staging, clears flag in own short tx; deletion failure safe report, durable pending remains; action committed result stays successful. Queue publish and cleanup callbacks both best-effort wakeups, independently recoverable, no throw erases committed result.
Outer rollback removes aggregate/pointers/work and returns session to original persisted assembled state, staged protocol source retained; callbacks do not run. Prepared CAS temporary resources still finally-cleaned; promoted unreferenced CAS objects handled by existing P1 orphan saga, not promise zero physical writes. Retry can reprepare from retained protocol staging. Crash after commit before callbacks: scan reconciler discovers obligation and committed cleanup flag. Crash after staging deletion before flag clear: idempotent delete/missing path counts cleanup success. Successful replay skips staging/ingest, may request cleanup wakeup, checks live scope/auth/payload, returns stored result once. Recovery never guesses successful head or re-ingests committed session.
P3.7 explicit files session model/store, CompleteUploadAction, UploadSessionManager, StagedUpload, Content/UploadCleanupReconciler plus scan reconciler command integration. Abort/expire existing CAS and safety semantics retained; product change focuses committed upload cleanup, not unsolicited lease redesign. C03 fault cases isolate postcommit cleanup from mandatory domain/event staging correction C05 (P5.1). No promise current swallowed RecordsOutbox is already atomic.

sections.title: Named scenario map, exact lanes and negative controls
sections.text:
These are future acceptance contracts, NOT executed tests. New named tests live only in owning packages and use existing Testbench/SchemaBuilder/ForkRace fixtures. Test descriptions include stable identifier listed below; no silent filter mismatch. All new acceptance commands in items/phase use exact cwd/env and scripts/php84, nonempty executed_tests>=1/skipped=0; receipts also include discovered/matched names, passed/failed counts, stdout/stderr, candidate and input dependency hashes. Every required named scenario must execute, not merely another test in same file. Actual migration up/down and data/FK/type output required SQLite/PG/MySQL. Product preflight/isolation applies at future run; current design starts no container, PHP, Pest or DB.

Existing sweep/patch mutex regressions retained. |

Legacy Document autosave/Yjs in-place and append actually participate; optional expectation applies to Document update, unconditional installed Yjs writer still bumps correctly without a false 412 promise. |

D06 limited negative controls per new enforcement/harness; isolated temporary copy, exact owned source byte SHA restoration, required test command/cwd/env recorded RED then original candidate GREEN; no mutation engine/campaign. Control→stable named scenario:
NC-SCOPE disable locator drive constraint→P3.1 OperationTaxonomy SEC-R14/foreign; NC-PROFILE skip profile gate→P3.6 ProfileGuardBoundary SEC-R14; NC-SEQ skip assertExpected→P3.3 NodeSequenceBoundary SEC-R18; NC-SEQ-BOUND skip max guard→NodeSequenceContract SEC-R20-overflow; NC-ADMISSION carry source admission on copy→DestinationScanPolicy SEC-R03; NC-EVIDENCE omit spec/drive equality→ScanEvidenceBoundary SEC-R06; NC-WORK suppress durable intent→ScanWorkRecovery SEC-R09; NC-FENCE omit token check→PG ScanWorkRecoveryRace SEC-R11; NC-QUARANTINE bypass gate→ContentDelivery SEC-R17; NC-DIRECT bypass strict mode→ContentDelivery SEC-R16; NC-CLEANUP discard after nested-return→CompleteUploadIdempotency SEC-R13; NC-SCANNER bypass tenant check→PrivateScannerTenantBoundary SEC-R12. sections.title: D06 failure playbook и future ownership
sections.text:
Config missing scanner/spec/rollout or stale deployed spec: fail closed, safe configuration error, repair binding/config and explicit activation; no implicit mode off. Scanner deterministic failure: settled failed with reason, required egress423; fix cause then explicit rescan request. Transient timeout/broker outage: bounded retry/republication, inspect durable state, no status clean by fallback. Lease stale/deleted identity: no-op/no foreign write, retained newer state. Corrupt immutable identity/tenant: deny before bytes, report safe code, stop+escalate owner; don't repair by taking caller blob/key. SQL deadlock retries bounded existing transaction3, name UNIQUE retry5, original expectation/source retained; exhausted failure rollback, never relax expectation. Counter overflow/negative schema failure: rollback+409/invalid argument, stop+escalate owner; no rollover or schema widening. Postcommit cleanup failure: return committed result, durable pending recovery; outer rollback retain staging. Schema engine/check unsupported or required PG/MySQL proof skipped/empty: stop item finish and escalate explicit missing qualification, don't call pass. Drift outside declared source closure: preserve unrelated changes, recalculate impacted qualification; source OPUS byte drift stop+owner escalation, no source rewrite. Incompatible unforeseen contract: stop+new D#, no implementation improvisation.
C05 P5.1 atomic mandatory EventRecorder staging still pending; C06 P5.3 fan-out before terminal, snapshot/checkpoint/dedup/prune/legacy ambiguity still pending; existing delivery lease/retry coverage retained. C07 P4.7 future Document/Yjs writers and P6.1/6.3 full validators/critical REST If-Match missing428/stale412; no second sequence migration. C08 P4.4 exporters/P6 HTTP/cache304/client contracts. C09 P7.1 doctor/P7.2 scheduler/P7.4 host tests/P7.6 docs. C10 P8.1 receipts matrix/P8.2 real data upgrades/P8.3 no essential correction unresolved at freeze. Design-only descriptions are not accepted qualification exceptions, and prior P0–P2 GREEN never substitutes their future correction proof.

sections.title: Prompt отправленный в Perplexity Deep Research
sections.text:
ROLE: Independent research architect. Research established production patterns for Vaulter's P3 design. Do not rubber-stamp the provisional A/A/A decisions. Challenge the framing, propose a better third option when evidence warrants, and clearly distinguish documented facts, analogy/inference, and your design recommendation. Produce the answer in Russian, preserving technical identifiers. Cite primary-source URLs near each substantive claim. Prioritize vendor official documentation, standards, and maintained open-source documentation or pinned source code; blogs only as leads. Check current behavior at retrieval time; note version/edition and exclusions. Do not infer proprietary internals from user-facing help pages. Report unknowns rather than inventing Google Drive behavior.

SYSTEM CONTEXT (repository-confirmed, not hypothetical):
Vaulter is an unpublished MIT PHP/Laravel modular file/document platform being designed for 1.0. No external consumer backwards compatibility is required, but database history and stored user data must be preserved. PHP ^8.4, Illuminate/Laravel supported ^12|^13; current local Laravel13.17, Pest4.7.4/PHPUnit12.5. It is an embeddable package suite, not a hosted AWS clone: core, drive, media, documents, Filament adapter, Azgard authorization adapter. Optional TipTap/Yjs collaboration and later Vue/REST integration. Core must not depend on optional drive/documents packages.
Canonical API Vaulter::drive(owner)->actingAs(user)->nodes()/folders()/files()/trash()/access()/shares()/activity(); explicit asSystem(nonempty reason). Immutable handles, no cached access decisions. Operations re-fetch passed node models by persisted key within authoritative drive/tenant; passed actorId/model fields are not authority. User View denial→404 concealment; ability denial→403; profile deny→ProfileRestriction403. Accepted narrow TOCTOU window: ACL prechecked outside SQL, structural/tenant invariants rechecked under lock. Public share fresh read after revoke commit→404; already delivered bytes cannot be revoked.
Runtime profiles are frozen core policies per drive: feature booleans/global AND profile; max size min; MIME allow predicates AND; blocked extensions union; required scan global OR profile. Per-profile permission drivers provide ACL; configured host drivers can allow ACL but shouldn't implicitly create tenant authority. Current proposal system bypasses ACL only; scope/profile/quarantine remain.
Strict tenant isolation applies also to system/queues. withoutTenancy is closure-scoped maintenance exception with finally restoration; not an HTTP input. Jobs carry scalar actor/drive/revision/blob/tenant IDs, rehydrate authority, and avoid worker tenant leakage.
Content: tree of folder/file/document/shortcut nodes; immutable file revision history; CAS blobs with tenant/drive/global deduplication scope, references determine liveness, transactional edge/quota updates, race-safe asynchronous GC/reconcile. Storage backends local or S3-compatible. A scan verdict is currently planned on a revision rather than automatically authoritative globally by sha. Avoid cross-tenant information leakage or unqualified global clean sharing.
Single/PHP/tus/S3 multipart completion converge on real-byte ingest, bounded stream reads (~64KiB), size/hash/MIME trusted only after actual reading. SQL retry reuses staged bytes, no second CAS. Completion result pointers committed atomically; replay creates no duplicate revision/event/job. Jobs currently specified after OUTERMOST SQL commit. No built-in mandatory AV vendor or cloud deployment.
Status model proposed scan_status=not_required|pending|clean|infected|failed; metadata remains ACL-visible in quarantine. Pending/failed block all byte egress when scan required, infected blocks always, clean permits. Every egress must gate before stream/signed URL/preview/export/thumbnail/public share/cache; no silent older-clean-head substitution. Old revision explicit read has its own verdict.
Historical upgrade fills existing revisions with not_required. New ingest when scan optional uses not_required, required uses pending+scan. Copy/restore inherit status; currently pending/failed new revisions get their own idempotent scan job after outermost commit, clean/infected/not_required inherited.
Purge is atomic per subtree with physical node deletion and document inline revision FK cascade; bulk maintenance isolates/report errors by root and continues. Copy unsupported document kinds fails before any subtree writes; no empty payload.
Concurrency: separate advisory/row lock families ordered session→tree→node→file→revision→quota→CAS→event writes. Optimistic expectedSequence compared under node lock before any side effects; successful mutation +1 within same DB transaction, no-op no bump. Idempotency key is separate from sequence, blob hash separate from ETag.
Project phases: P0/P1/P2 closed; P3 authorized PHP API/security/profiles/upload/quarantine/tenancy; P4 document aggregate/lifecycle; P5 domain event/outbox integration; P6 REST. P3 public API already promises expectedSequence/StaleNodeException412, but existing governance assigned creation of v_nodes.sequence to P4.7. Current repair moves only foundation to P3.3, P4.7 extends new Document writers/REST ETag contract (REST activation P6).
We are doing RESEARCH ONLY now. No product implementation, accepted decisions, independent audit, or phase closure. Next session will finalize design. Three questions remain OPEN. Current provisional choices must be tested against evidence.

QUESTION 1 — scanner policy vs legacy/copy/restore content (D26/F05/F04):
A currently proposed: not_required remains readable unconditionally after required is enabled, preserving legacy availability; new required ingest scans.
B: require clean for all reads after required enabled, block legacy and introduce explicit rescan/backfill.
Find established alternatives: separate scan fact from enforcement policy; modes off/new-uploads-only/all-content; explicit grandfathering; policy epoch/scanner version/signature freshness; scan verdict keyed by revision vs immutable object version/blob digest with scope; background backfill with explicit cutover/rollout; failure/unsupported/too-large/password-protected states; fail-open/closed handling. Explain if A silently weakens 'required' and if B needlessly breaks availability. For unpublished software what should the default mean? Should policy choice be explicit rather than an opaque not_required exception? Who controls it? What semantics should copy or restore have when source not_required but destination requires scan? Distinguish same-content/same-scope copy, cross-drive/profile/tenant copy, same hash but new object version, clean result under changed scanner/policy, infected inheritance, stale verdict, quarantine effects of a scanner outage.
Use Amazon GuardDuty Malware Protection for S3 (event-driven new objects vs on-demand existing objects, tags and IAM/TBAC, outcomes/failures/copy metadata/events), Azure Defender for Storage (on-upload/on-demand scanning, existing blob behavior, access gating/private endpoints, result trust), Google Drive documented malware limits/download restrictions (not claims about internal AV), Nextcloud/files_antivirus and other maintained OSS as appropriate. If an on-demand feature is newer distinguish it and mark historical/outdated pages. Explicitly assess event delivery gaps, afterCommit isn't a durable dispatch guarantee, crash after commit before queue publish, idempotence vs at-least-once durability; existing outbox in repo is not automatic P3 adoption. Signed URLs may survive app revocation/status changes: identify achievable contract vs exact storage enforcement, TTL and version pinning. Do not expand into enterprise AV deployment; propose minimum adequate portable core and deliberate extensions.
Deliver a full access matrix for status × effective scan mode incl legacy, scanner outage, copy/restore/destination requirements and specific counterexample tests.

QUESTION 2 — system actor and non-bypassable policy (D27/F06):
A: system bypasses object ACL only, profile/tenant/quarantine/invariants remain enforced.
B: early system-return also bypasses profile restrictions.
Compare AWS IAM permissions boundaries/SCP/resource policies (explicit deny and documented root/service-linked-role exceptions), Google Shared Drive restrictions vs service accounts/domain-wide delegation vs actual administrator actions, Azure/RBAC if relevant, OSS service-account/system-job patterns, OPA/Cedar capabilities/principal/context models.
Do NOT equate our in-process trusted system actor with an IAM principal without stating limits. Categorize actor identity, object ACL, resource/business feature policy, security scan, data invariants, tenant scope, maintenance capabilities. Decide which are inviolable and which may need narrowly scoped admin/recovery exemptions. Evaluate broad asSystem vs explicit service principal/capabilities/reason/audit; avoid a generic bypassPolicy flag. Does a profile disabling uploads/downloads/shares accidentally prevent purge/repair? What exact policy applies to deletion/cleanup of infected files? Can maintenance jobs progress without public data egress? Where does break-glass belong if at all in MVP? Give guard order/error semantics, owner binding (P3.1 seam→P3.6 policy implementation), system/user/maintenance tests.

QUESTION 3 — optimistic concurrency and sequence foundation timing (D28/F08):
A: sequence column/locked compare+bump in P3.3 to satisfy promised PHP API, later Document writers and REST ETag use it.
B: postpone to P4.7 and redesign earlier API contract.
Compare established Google Drive revision/version semantics (is version a useful precondition? do not assume files.update supports If-Match from generic HTTP), Google Cloud Storage generation/metageneration preconditions, S3 conditional requests/If-Match and distinction ETag vs hash/multipart/versionId, Azure Blob ETag concurrency, Nextcloud WebDAV conditional updates, HTTP RFC9110 conditional requests/strong vs weak ETag.
Define what node sequence counts and which writers must participate: name, parent, trash/restore, content replacement, grants/shares/profile/child-list changes/scan status, revision pruning and asynchronous verdict updates. Distinguish node metadata revision from file content version and collection/list version; a strong ETag must change for all representation changes and authorization-dependent representations may complicate caching. Avoid exposing untrusted sequence int from caller/model as authoritative. Ensure two expected7 writers produce one success8/one412 with no side effects; optional expectedSequence vs mandatory protocol precondition, retries safe/no blind retry after stale; batch/subtree multiple-node semantics, rollback/idempotency, create/copy initial0. Single column vs multiple counters and portable unsigned semantics PostgreSQL/MySQL. Assess whether broad 'all mutations' wording is underspecified and whether stage foundation early with ownership amendment is the only compilable honest option.
Recommend minimum correct P3 version scope and P4/P6 contracts without overengineering.

OUTPUT:
1. Summary recommendation for each D26/D27/D28, including rejection/revision of current A choices if needed, reasoning, tradeoffs, and evidence strength.
2. Comparison table by system (documented feature, limits, what applies to Vaulter, what does not); at least 2 genuinely relevant primary-source anchors per question, no manufactured parity.
3. Separate scan fact/enforcement and system privilege/concurrency models with concrete state/access/copy/restore/error tables.
4. 10–20 adversarial acceptance scenarios across decisions, including process-crash/event-loss, unscanned→required copy, destination policy, tenant/scope, concurrent metadata vs content, scanner failure, signed URL permanence.
5. Which repairs already recorded for P3 need revision; minimal portable design now vs explicitly later features. Explain if durable scan dispatch or storage-layer URL enforcement must be prerequisites instead of falsely claiming them solved.
6. Open choices only genuinely requiring owner product preference; recommend a coherent package default without claiming an 'ideal' universally best system.
7. Primary URLs with exact section/version/verification limits. No long quotations. If no published evidence exists say so.
Bound the answer to roughly 3500–5000 Russian words; prioritize accurate sources and actionable contracts over number of citations.

sections.title: Уточнение пропавших matrices и сценариев
sections.text: Уточнение к независимому исследованию Vaulter PHP8.4/Laravel12–13 file+CAS+revision+tenant/profile system. В Deep Research ответе пропали содержимое таблиц и acceptance сценарии при выгрузке. Ответь ТОЛЬКО простыми нумерованными списками, без таблиц/кодовых блоков, 1500–2200 слов. Нужны (1) access matrix словами для unscanned/not_required,pending,clean,infected,failed при off,new_content_only,all_content; legacy grandfathering явно зафиксирован, не произвольный timestamp; off не разрешает known infected; fresh optional background rescan failure не уничтожает ещё принимаемый clean evidence; (2) copy/restore: source not_required→required destination, clean evidence same bytes vs changed scanner/scope/tenant; trash restore vs creating new revision; (3) 12 конкретных adversarial cases по durable scan work (commit→publish crash, expired lease/late result), signed URL fresh request after revoke vs in-flight download, system scanner internal read vs публичный bypass, root expectedSequence vs changed descendant и conditional read ETag+304 after revoked auth. (4) Проверь и дай первичные источники отдельно по D27 IAM explicit denies/SCP service-linked exceptions/Cedar и D28 GCS generation+metageneration/Azure If-Match/RFC9110 strong vs node counter. Отдельно: есть ли опубликованное основание требовать BIGINT вместо portable uint32 в Vaulter, или это лишь выбор по throughput/lifetime? Нельзя выдавать предпочтение исследователя за обязательное требование стандарта. existing P3 spec unsignedInteger default0 нельзя менять только 'потому что у Google большое число'. Все свои проекты решений обозначай рекомендациями, а не фактами Google internals. Достоверность tags/необходимость восстановления потерянного scan dispatch проверять по AWS/Azure official. Sources URLs рядом с claims. Это только исследование; не принимать решения и не изменять код.

sections.title: Короткая сверка ordering/durability и integer portability
sections.text: Дай краткий самостоятельный ответ максимум 450 слов по двум спорным утверждениям, с 4–6 прямыми ссылками первичных источников рядом с тезисами, без таблиц. 1) Что именно гарантирует Laravel13 afterCommit()/after_commit и решает ли оно потерю job при crash после DB commit, до queue publish? Отличить ordering/idempotency от durable dispatch; подтверждение transactional outbox — AWS official guidance. 2) Vaulter использует PHP8.4 64bit+PG/MySQL и планирует unsignedInteger sequence default0. Google Cloud Storage generation и Azure ETag доказывают need CAS, но требуют ли они BIGINT для нашего собственного node counter? PostgreSQL integer32 signed, MySQL integer32 unsigned; Laravel PostgresGrammar не поддерживает unsigned modifier. Как корректно определить общий домен, overflow behavior и выбор int32 vs bigint64 без выдуманного обязательного стандарта? RFC9110 strong ETag полный JSON с динамическими ACL/scan полями отдельно от command-visible node sequence. Это research, не implementation.
