Residual limits, not separate defects: the single-node walk is still documented as depth-capped, while `withMaxDepth(64)` does not cap negative ancestor depths, and the batch walk matches that live behavior. SQLite path-suffix cycle checks remain the dependency’s own rule on both walks. `VaulterSharedWithMe` still shows the empty-list copy when the first cursor page has no visible rows; `hasMore` stays true and the Load more control stays available, which is the continuation the candidate covers in `useSharedNodes`.

sections.title: 1. Major — batch ancestor walk drops grants that `effectiveGrants()` still applies
sections.text:
**Location:** `packages/core/src/Repositories/Drive/NodeReadRepository.php:179-181` (`ancestorChains`), compared with `packages/core/src/Access/AccessResolver.php:658-679` (`ancestorChain`).

**Trigger:** A node has more than 64 ancestors and `inherit_grants` stays true along that path. A subtree deny (or the only allow) sits on an ancestor above that cut. The usual leak is a host role allow, such as Reader, plus that far deny.

**Consequence:** `evaluateMany()` never loads that ancestor, so the role allow is not vetoed. Children, search, trash, shared, folder `show` children, and the Filament table can return the node’s name, size, and MIME. `AccessResolver::can(View)` still denies it, because `ancestors()` keeps walking. The mirror case hides a node whose only allow is above the cut, so a direct open succeeds and the listing omits it.

**Evidence:** The new CTE seeds the parent at depth 0 and stops with `c.depth < DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH - 1` (`64 - 1`). That keeps ancestors 1 through 64 and drops the 65th. `effectiveGrants()` uses staudenmeir `ancestors()`, which seeds the parent at depth `-1` and then subtracts. `withMaxDepth(64)` compiles `"depth" < 64`. Every negative depth satisfies that predicate, so the walk continues to the root (or the database recursion limit). `EvaluateManyEquivalenceTest` only builds trees of depth ≤ 5, so this split stays green.

**Repair:** Make `ancestorChains()` cover the same ancestors as `ancestorChain()`. The positive `c.depth < 63` bound is tighter than the live `ancestors()` walk. Add one equivalence tree deeper than 64 whose deciding grant sits on the root.

sections.title: 2. Major — official shared client still pages with `page` / `total`
sections.text:
**Location:** `packages/vue/src/composables/useSharedNodes.ts:47-89` and `packages/vue/src/client.ts:152-158`, against `packages/drive/src/Http/Controllers/NodeController.php:76-86` and `364-376`.

**Trigger:** `GET /shared` now returns `meta.next_cursor`, `per_page`, and `scanned`, and omits `current_page`, `last_page`, and `total`. `useSharedNodes` still calls `client.nodes.shared({ page })` and sets `hasMore` from `current_page < last_page`.

**Consequence:** The first page still loads, because the API ignores `page` and returns the first cursor page. `hasMore` stays false, and `loadMore()` returns without a request. Shared nodes past the first page never appear in `@vaulter/vue`. `useNodes` already follows `next_cursor`; only the shared composable is still on the old envelope.

**Repair:** Point `shared()` and `useSharedNodes` at the same cursor envelope as the other listings (`CursorMeta`, send `cursor`, stop when `next_cursor` is null). That client lives outside the P1.3 PHP file list; the in-repo client is still wrong after this API change.

sections.title: Findings
sections.text:
**1. Major — repair and GC mark acquire the same CAS locks in opposite orders.** `packages/media/src/Console/RepairBlobScopesCommand.php:120-123` vs `packages/media/src/Cas/BlobGarbageCollector.php:344-346`. Introduced.

`commit`, sweep, and orphan prune each take one `cas:{scope_key}:{sha256}` lock. Mark is different: on PostgreSQL it locks every candidate in the batch in `hashtext` order inside one transaction. Repair always takes two locks, the legacy source and the target, after `sort(..., SORT_STRING)`.

`ref_count` stays 0 until reconcile, including blobs that already have edges, so both rows are normal mark candidates. After the upgrade this is the usual mixed state: a `legacy:snull` or `legacy:tnull` blob, and a `drive:{id}` or `tenant:{id}` blob for the same sha256 created by a new upload or an older numeric row.

Trigger: `vaulter:gc-blobs` during `vaulter:blobs:repair-scopes --execute`, with both rows in one mark batch of 1000 and `hashtext('cas:legacy:…')` ordered opposite to `hashtext('cas:drive:…')` (about half of pairs; `drive:` sorts before `legacy:`). Mark holds the legacy key and waits for the drive key. Repair holds the drive key and waits for the legacy key. PostgreSQL aborts one transaction with `40P01`. Mark has no deadlock retry, so the GC batch fails. Repair retries the whole copy up to three times and can still exit 1. The rolled-back transaction does not drop bytes, but both operators stop. On MySQL the advisory lock is a no-op; the same window deadlocks when the target row id is lower than the source id, because repair locks the source row and then the target row, while mark locks the batch by primary key.

`commit` against repair does not deadlock: a writer takes only one CAS lock, and both sides take the tree lock before any CAS lock.

**2. Minor — required V14 dry-run check is not what the test asserts.** `packages/media/tests/Cas/RepairBlobScopesCommandTest.php:12663`. Introduced test gap, not a product logic bug by itself.

The spec says a `legacy:snull` blob with edges in storages A and B prints two `move` rows. The test only checks that the output contains the substring `move`. One row would still pass. The command does group by target key, so two storages should produce two rows, but the acceptance test does not lock that.

**3. Minor — the guide’s opening diagram still shows only the old key.** `docs/guide/storage-and-blobs.md` (mental model: `"<scope>/ab/cd/<sha256>"`). The later scope section is correct (`g|t-|d-` plus the legacy two-shard layout). `ContentStore::keyFor`’s docblock still describes only `ab/cd`. Operators following the diagram will misread new paths. Not a runtime bug.

sections.title: What holds
sections.text:
`BlobScope` keeps ids as raw strings. UUID, ULID, leading zeroes, `/`, and `équipe` round-trip; non-canonical segments are rejected. The unit tests for that passed on PostgreSQL (20 passed in `upgrade-unit-pg`, including migration №7 on the bigint and ulid fixtures).

New commits lock and insert on `scope_key`, not nullable `tenant_id`/`storage_id`. `forUpload` maps null tenant to `global()` and does not use `is_numeric`. Existing rows keep their `storage_key` and `disk`. Re-promotion writes to the row’s path, not to a newly computed `keyFor`, so old `global/…` and `t12/…` objects stay authoritative. Orphan decisions use that full path, then `keyFor(fromSegment(segment), sha) === path`, so a legacy object and a new-layout object for the same `scope_key` are not treated as the same file.

Migration №7 fills `scope_key`, sets NOT NULL, adds `{table}_scope_sha_uniq`, and only then drops `{table}_dedup_uniq`. A unique conflict leaves the old index in place. `down()` restores the dedup index from the current `dedup.scope` before dropping `scope_key`. It does not move objects. `Config::table()` still honors prefix and `table_names`.

Repair is one mode or exit 2, batches of 100, and one transaction per target. It checks the source sha256, copies only through the target row’s path, verifies the target bytes, retargets `file_version_blobs.blob_id` and `file_versions.blob_id`, recounts `ref_count` from edges, and leaves the old object for GC. `hash_mismatch` does not set the failure exit. A thrown copy is exit 1 and a later `--execute` only sees edges that are still on the legacy blob. `legacy:tnull` with a null storage tenant becomes `global`. Unreferenced blobs are reported and not changed. The journal line is the specified JSON, written after commit.

sections.title: Content
sections.text:
The three earlier findings are fixed, and the lock change does not reopen a byte-loss or lock-order cycle.

PostgreSQL repair and batched mark both call `BlobLock::acquireMany`, which locks distinct `hashtext` values in numeric order. The new regression picks a pair where `hashtext('cas:legacy:snull:…')` is lower than `hashtext('cas:drive:…')`, so the old lexical order was the opposite. GC holds that lower lock, waits until the repair session is actually waiting on an advisory lock, then marks the batch with deadlock retries disabled. The repair command acquires the target once, exits 0, moves the revision, leaves `ref_count` at 1, and the source object remains readable. The old run retried the target acquisition (`attempts` 2). Single-key commit, sweep, and prune still take one lock and cannot invert this order. An absent target has no row and no second lock.

On MySQL the advisory call is a no-op. Repair and mark both take `FOR UPDATE` through `PRIMARY` in ascending primary-key order before any per-row repository lock. An absent target is not in that scan, so it cannot be locked in the opposite order. This path was inspected, not concurrency-tested. A primary scan can lock extra rows, but only in the same direction as mark, so it does not recreate the deadlock. The 32-bit `hashtext` collision behavior is unchanged.

The dry-run test now requires two `| move |` rows and both `drive:{id}` values. The guide diagram and `ContentStore::keyFor` describe `<scope>/ab/<sha256>`, and the legacy `ab/cd` layout remains documented. V01 plants two rowless objects per case and compares the exact orphan-key list. All nine identifier and scope cases passed on SQLite (84 assertions) and again inside the PostgreSQL CAS run.

The numeric-coercion mutant fails the ULID and UUID7 storage cases with `drive:missing` (2 failed, 7 passed). The restored `BlobScope` matches `c7e6fca4…` and passes all 9. The code-guidance search reports no matches.

Current gates, all exit 0: PostgreSQL CAS 141 passed and 4 skipped, including V13, V14, and the lock-order test; the focused lock-order rerun 19 passed; core Pest 662 passed; drive Pest 499 passed; core and drive PHPStan and Pint clean; media SQLite Pest, PHPStan, and Pint clean; migration and `BlobScope` unit tests 20 passed.

No remaining findings.

On MySQL both take row locks through the primary index in ascending primary-key order before individual repository access. The repair scan uses the primary index to include a not-yet-created target and prevent opposite source/target order; MySQL was inspected, not concurrency-tested locally.
2. Minor: dry-run acceptance now asserts exactly two move table rows and both target drive identifiers.
3. Minor: opening diagram and ContentStore::keyFor documentation now show the new one-shard layout while retaining the legacy-layout contract.
4. Evidence gap: V01 creates two real rowless objects and asserts exact orphan keys in all nine ID/scope combinations.

Regression: a forked repair runs while GC owns the lower actual PostgreSQL lock. The barrier waits for the repair's real pg_stat_activity advisory wait, then GC marks its batch. The old implementation deadlocks and retries (red log: two target acquisitions versus one); the new implementation completes once and preserves revision pointer, target references and readable bytes. PostgreSQL activity snapshots are refreshed during the bounded wait. No sleep-based scheduling assumption.

P1.6 holds the quota, revision, lock-order, and staging contracts on the paths that were traced. A positive quota delta is one conditional `UPDATE`. Revision numbers come from the locked file counter. Copies reserve the frozen subtree once. PostgreSQL races are set up so a broken reservation or a missing file lock fails for the reason the item names.

sections.title: What holds
sections.text:
Quota truth is the conditional update in `StorageStoreRepository::reserveBytes()` (`packages/core/src/Repositories/Drive/StorageStoreRepository.php:24–43`). For `delta > 0` the statement is `used_bytes = used_bytes + ?` only when `quota_bytes IS NULL` or `used_bytes + ? <= quota_bytes`, on `VaulterDatabase::connection()`. Zero rows refresh the storage and throw `QuotaExceededException`; the caller’s transaction rolls back. `delta <= 0` goes to `adjustUsedBytes()`, which clamps at 0. On PostgreSQL this is atomic under `READ COMMITTED`: the second updater blocks on the storage row and rechecks the `WHERE`. On MySQL the same statement is atomic, and `lockTreeShared()` already holds that row. On SQLite the single writer plus this `WHERE` is the quota gate. An exact boundary passes; one byte over matches zero rows.

`UploadFileAction::executeUpload()` (`packages/drive/src/Actions/UploadFileAction.php:79–148`) stages once, then opens `transaction(..., 3)`. The fast `assertWithinQuota()` runs only for a new file (`:87–89`). A revision skips it, so a stale in-memory head cannot reject a shrink. Inside the transaction the order is shared drive lock, destination or target node, file aggregate for a revision (`:107`), head size from `current_version_id` (`:108–112`), `reserveBytes` or `adjustUsedBytes` (`:114–118`), then `commitStaged` (`:125`). The required comment is at `:92`. A new file gets `version_no` 1. A revision gets `$file->version_count + 1` (`:216`) and `repointHead` writes that number (`:230`), not an in-memory increment. `FileVersionStoreRepository::nextVersionNo()` is gone. No `nextVersionNo` call remains in the supplied core or drive sources.

`CopyNodeAction` (`packages/drive/src/Actions/CopyNodeAction.php:69–100`) takes the shared drive lock, snapshots the subtree, locks those nodes and the destination in one `ORDER BY id` `FOR UPDATE`, copies that set, and calls `reserveBytes` once with the sum. Trashed children stay out of the copy (`whereNull('trashed_at')`), which matches the copy rule that trash is not duplicated. Quota failure rolls the whole copy back. The locked node is what is copied, so a stale caller sees the head that committed before the node lock: upload updates node size and file head before it releases that lock.

Lock levels on the PostgreSQL paths do not step backward. Upload and copy take drive, then nodes, then (upload revision) the file row, then the quota update, then CAS. `commitStaged` (`packages/media/src/Cas/BlobStore.php:48–67`) takes `cas:{scope_key}:{sha256}` before `findOrCreate` and promote, and it does not discard. `commit()` is stage, `commitStaged`, `discard` in `finally`. Promote stays outside SQL rollback. `FileUploaded`, `NodeVersionCommitted`, and `NodeCopied` implement `ShouldDispatchAfterCommit`. The byte counter is recorded after the upload transaction returns. `VaulterDatabase::transaction()` defaults to 3 attempts (`packages/core/src/Database/VaulterDatabase.php:34`), and upload and copy pass 3. Move, restore, and force-delete keep drive-then-nodes; force-delete still releases bytes only through `adjustUsedBytes`. `detach`/`attach` take no CAS lock, so force-delete does not take level 5 and then level 4.

`BlobStore::commitStaged` is on the contract and in `packages/core/tests/Arch/__snapshots__/public-api.txt`. The media class implements it. Changelog `[Unreleased]` records the method and the E2/AD21 fix. Both guides describe conditional quota, drive → nodes → file → quota → CAS, head deltas, the three-attempt reuse of the staged object, and the promote saga.

V02 places the two 8 MiB uploads under different parents, so the parent lock cannot hide a broken quota update. Both pre-checks see 10 MiB free; only the conditional update can leave one winner, `used_bytes` equal to that head, and one blob row. Reconcile is aimed at the winner’s key after its mtime is older than grace. V03’s upload race uses two different sizes, so `used_bytes == final head` fails if both deltas were taken from the original head. The second V03 test locks only the file row, with a 100 ms overlap and no node lock, and expects `{2, 3}`.

sections.title: Related observations
sections.text:
Inherited, MySQL and SQLite. `lockTreeShared()` locks the storage row, which is also the quota row, and it does that before node locks. PostgreSQL uses a shared advisory tree lock and only later updates the row. Both upload and copy take that MySQL row first, so they queue on it instead of inverting node and quota.

Inherited, same-level node locks. `RestoreNodeAction` locks the node and root, then locks the original parent. `RenameNodeAction` locks the node, then its parent. The tree lock is what keeps those from running beside a move. P1.6 does not add a lower level after a higher one there.

Introduced doc residue, low. `docs/guide/uploads.md` still describes assemble as `UploadFileAction` → `BlobStore::commit`, and the CAS diagram in `docs/guide/storage-and-blobs.md` still shows `commit()` as the only entry. The new sections above those paragraphs are the accurate contract. Repair by pointing the assemble steps and the diagram at `stage` → `commitStaged` → caller `discard`.

The raw OPUS V20 row still expects `x.pdf` and `x (2).pdf`. The item scope excludes `OnNameConflict::Rename` and requires one node plus `NodeNameConflictException`. The test follows the item scope.

The raw OPUS V02 line calls the loser’s blob an orphan. Quota now runs before promote, so the loser never inserts a blob row and never promotes. That is the item’s V02 assertion. A row-less object still appears only when promote happens and a later SQL failure rolls the row back. `commitStaged`’s rollback test keeps the temp file, recommits, and dedups. Reconcile deletes a key only when it has no blob row, is past grace, and still has no row under the CAS lock.

sections.title: Evidence and limits
sections.text:
Author evidence in this pass is core Pint and PHPStan, both exit 0, plus the negative controls: quota control exit 1 once, revision control exit 1 on all five runs. The supplied note matches the aggregate test: with the upload node lock still present, removing `FileStoreRepository::lockForUpdate` is what produces duplicate `(file_id, version_no)`. The positive PostgreSQL suite, the SQLite `QuotaReserveTest` run, and the media CAS run are not in this evidence. They were not re-executed here.

V21 checks ten iterations of move-into-F beside upload-into-F, an acyclic tree, and `used_bytes` equal to the sum of file head sizes. It does not record retry counts, so the OPUS “at most one retry” bound is not measured. The lock sequence above is why a deadlock between those two should not form: each takes the tree lock before any node lock, and shared and exclusive advisory locks on that key queue.

`TusConcurrentPatchTest.php`, `ResolvesVaulterConnection`, and `CommitUploadAction` were not in the source bundle. Direct uploads stage outside any transaction. `UploadSessionManager::commitAssembled()` already holds the session row across the commit callable, which is the existing sweeper barrier. The inner upload retry still reuses one staged object. An assembled stream is seekable, and `Sha256ContentStore::stage()` rewinds seekable streams.

Concurrency tests use `DatabaseMigrations`, not `RefreshDatabase` (`packages/drive/tests/Pest.php`). `ForkRace` skips unless the driver is PostgreSQL, refuses a database name that does not end in `_test`, and gives each child its own connection. SQLite coverage of this item is `QuotaReserveTest`: unlimited quota, exact boundary, one byte over with `used_bytes` unchanged, zero and negative release, subtree copy over quota with no new rows, stale revision head, and stale copy head.

sections.title: Exception boundary
sections.text:
`StorageStoreRepository::reserveBytes()` throws `Vaulter\Exceptions\Drive\QuotaExceededException` (`packages/core/src/Repositories/Drive/StorageStoreRepository.php:41–46`). That name does not match the architecture scan `Vaulter\Drive\`, which `coreReferencesTo('Drive')` still requires to be empty (`packages/core/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php:3568–3569`). No ignore was added.

The core class is a non-final `ProblemException` with code `quota_exceeded` and status 413 (`packages/core/src/Exceptions/Drive/QuotaExceededException.php:18–42`). `Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\QuotaExceededException` extends it and its `forStorage()` factory returns the Drive type (`packages/drive/src/Exceptions/QuotaExceededException.php:8–15`). `UploadFileAction` rethrows a Drive exception unchanged and wraps only a core exception (`packages/drive/src/Actions/UploadFileAction.php:166–167`). The pre-check still throws the Drive type directly. `CopyNodeAction` wraps the repository exception at the action boundary (`packages/drive/src/Actions/CopyNodeAction.php:105–107`). `QuotaReserveTest` expects the core type from the repository and the Drive type from `copy()`. Both classes render 413 `quota_exceeded`. `UPGRADE.md` states that split.

`NodeCopied` now carries the locked source `$current` (`CopyNodeAction.php:101`), so the after-commit payload is the row read under the node lock.

sections.title: Tests that close the earlier gaps
sections.text:
The retry fixture writes `retry the same bytes` into a non-seekable socket pair and closes the writer before `upload()` (`packages/drive/tests/Concurrency/RevisionNumberRaceTest.php:101–126`). `stage()` does not rewind a socket. A second read of that stream would hash empty bytes. The committed blob hash is `hash('sha256', 'retry the same bytes')`, `used_bytes` is 20, and the temp file is gone. The prepared object is what the retry committed.

V21 counts `TransactionBeginning` only at `transactionLevel() === 1` and expects 1 or 2 for each actor (`LockOrderRaceTest.php:10–34`). Nested `commitStaged` savepoints stay at level 2, so they do not count. That is one original attempt plus at most one retry.

The copy/dedup overlap test (`LockOrderRaceTest.php:48–107`) makes the upload reach `reserveBytes`, then waits until `pg_stat_activity` shows the copy backend blocked on `update "v_storages" set used_bytes`. Both actions are wrapped with attempt count 1. They use different parents, so they do not queue on the same node lock. An `UPDATE` of non-key `used_bytes` is `FOR NO KEY UPDATE`, which does not block the copy’s foreign-key `FOR KEY SHARE`, so the copy can insert and then wait on its own quota update. Both finish, and `used_bytes` is three logical heads. That matches the report that this window does not deadlock. MySQL still serializes same-storage writers on the storage row taken by `lockTreeShared()`.

`commitStaged` rollback now uses `BlobScope::global()` (`BlobCommitAtomicityTest.php:104`), so the blob row does not write a non-numeric `storage_id` under the bigint id strategy. The temp file survives the rollback and the second commit dedups.

`ResolvesVaulterConnection` uses an explicit model connection when one is set, otherwise `Config::connection()` (`packages/core/src/Models/Concerns/ResolvesVaulterConnection.php:31–38`). File and storage locks and the quota `UPDATE` share `VaulterDatabase`’s transaction.

The public guide diagram and the assemble section now name `commitStaged`. `CommitUploadAction`’s class comment still says `BlobStore.commit` (`packages/drive/src/Actions/Uploads/CommitUploadAction.php:27–31`). The action itself goes through `UploadFileAction`, which calls `commitStaged`. That comment is leftover wording, not a second commit path.

MIME mismatches are 422 `upload_rejected` with `reason: mime_mismatch`. The V24 dataset, architecture ignores, error guide, changelog, and upgrade note cover that set. The supplied gates exit 0, V24 reports 20 passed, and the negative controls go red and then green.

sections.title: P1.9 — Middleware stacks and local resource resolution
sections.text:
Implemented authenticated/public/hub stacks, automatic request metrics, legacy authenticated fallback, local swappable storage/node resolution and binding priority. Removed global route binders. Protected routes default to auth:sanctum; public shares and signed hub calls retain their own token/signature gates and throttles. Existing paths and controller model arguments are preserved. Configuration, installation, upgrade and changelog are updated. The core API golden now freezes Config accessors and HttpResourceResolver.

V25: 4 passed; unauthenticated protected request 401, Sanctum actor 200, anonymous valid share 200, valid signed hub JWT 200 with allowed=true. V26: 3 passed; host model resolves, missing storage/node 404 with drive_not_found/node_not_found. Both specified negative controls exit 1 and restore exact source bytes; focused suites green after restoration.

15 effective package gates GREEN (validation-effective.json): core 596 passed/11 skipped/17 risky; drive 454 passed/8 skipped/2 risky; documents 249 passed/1 skipped; media 128 passed/9 skipped/4 risky; filament 76 passed/1 skipped. Conditional skips and existing risky cases are not claimed executed. Testing uses explicit APP_ENV=testing, SQLite :memory:, serial execution and existing fake filesystem fixtures.

Initial core PHPStan rejected three inferred types. Corrected by reading the mixed parameter array, typing the next Closure and moving the kernel check into a contract-typed helper; no ignores or lowered thresholds. Core Pint/PHPStan/Pest rerun GREEN. API golden regenerated under the approved AD31 change.

Sanctum ^4.0 installed with Laravel 13.34.0. Full Composer dry-run with Laravel ^12.0 succeeds (composer-sanctum-l12-dry-run.log); partial attempts failed because L13 dependencies were locked, not because Sanctum was incompatible. addToMiddlewarePriorityBefore verified in installed sources and official Laravel 12.x/13.x Kernel sources. This is resolver compatibility plus source verification, not a full L12 test run.

sections.title: Content
sections.text:
**GREEN.** The packet’s three stacks, parameter resolver, and binding removal match the P1.9 isolation rules, and the V25/V26 claims line up with that code.

**Authentication isolation.** Owner routes in `packages/core/routes/api.php`, `packages/drive/routes/drive.php`, and `packages/documents/routes/documents.php` use `Config::authenticatedMiddleware()` (`api` + `auth:sanctum` + metrics). `share/{token}`, `share/{token}/nodes`, and `share/{token}/download` are a separate group on `publicMiddleware()` plus `throttle:vaulter-public` and `ResolveShareToken`. `collab/authenticate` and `collab/store` stay behind the same feature flag and use `hubMiddleware()` plus `throttle:vaulter-public` and `ResolveCollaborationCall`. A missing Sanctum token is 401 on `GET storages/{id}/nodes`, while a live share and a signed hub JWT stay on their own stacks (V25).

**Binding order.** `ResolveVaulterRouteParameters` is only on groups that already use `SubstituteBindings`, and it is inserted immediately before `SubstituteBindings` via `addToMiddlewarePriorityBefore` in `VaulterServiceProvider`. Scalar `storage` / `node` values are replaced with repository models before implicit binding; an existing model is left alone. `registerRouteBindings()` is gone, so a host `/projects/{node}` with `HostProject` resolves to that model (V26).

**404 codes.** `HttpResourceResolver` maps a null repository result to `StorageNotFoundException::forId` / `NodeNotFoundException::forId`. The drive tests assert 404 with `drive_not_found` and `node_not_found`.

**Legacy fallback and metrics.** A non-null `vaulter.middleware` replaces only the authenticated list (`[]` stays an override). `public` and `hub` always read `vaulter.routes.middleware.*`. `withRequestMetrics()` appends `RecordVaulterRequestMetrics` once per stack. The legacy assertion `['api', RecordVaulterRequestMetrics::class]` matches that behavior.

sections.text:
{
  "candidate_sha256": "29f8a7950e9b92d639e37746c5dc7a04be8f96411a25e3d6ccc00a37a9965126",
  "findings": [
    {
      "area": "drive FQN canon",
      "evidence": "packages/drive/src/DriveContext.php:40-65 implements Vaulter\\Contracts\\Drive\\DriveHandle with storage()/panel(); packages/core/src/Contracts/Drive/DriveHandle.php:24-26 requires model(): Drive and profile(): Profile; packages/drive/src/StorageManager.php:95 dispatches StorageCreated; packages/drive/src/DriveProvisioner.php:95 dispatches DriveCreated; packages/drive/src/Activity/RecordsDriveActivity.php:48 listens only for DriveCreated; UPGRADE.md:11-12 claims the old names are gone; both trees are present under packages/drive/src/{Actions,Data,Events,Exceptions,Http,Support/Uploads} and the new domain directories.",
      "file": "packages/drive/src/DriveContext.php",
      "line": 40,
      "risk_class": "local",
      "scenario": "Loading Vaulter\\Drive\\DriveContext is a fatal error: it implements Vaulter\\Contracts\\Drive\\DriveHandle but still declares storage(): Drive and panel(): string and does not declare the required model(): Drive or profile(): Profile. The 03 §4 renames were copied into the new namespaces and the old files were left autoloadable (DriveContext beside DriveHandle, StorageManager beside DriveProvisioner, Actions\\CreateFolderAction beside Actions\\Nodes\\CreateFolderAction, Events\\StorageCreated beside Events\\Drives\\DriveCreated, and the same fork for the other Actions, Data, Events, Exceptions, Http requests/resources/controllers, and Support\\Uploads\\StagedUpload/MagicByteSniffer). The required code-guidance scan is therefore not empty, and UPGRADE.md states that those old names have no aliases. Resolving the leftover StorageManager still dispatches StorageCreated from provision(), while the live DriveProvisioner path dispatches DriveCreated and RecordsDriveActivity/RecordsDriveOutbox listen only for DriveCreated, so that leftover provisioner writes neither an activity row nor an outbox row. In-repo callers still import the old types, including load/app/Console/PrepareMemoryFixturesCommand.php.",
      "severity": "blocker"
    },
    {
      "area": "drive domain event catalog",
      "evidence": "docs/reference/events.md:90-107 lists StorageCreated and NodeCreated under Vaulter\\Drive\\Events and says StorageCreated fires when Vaulter::for() get-or-creates a drive; docs/ru/reference/events.md:96-107 repeats that; packages/drive/src/DriveProvisioner.php:95 dispatches DriveCreated; packages/drive/src/Actions/Nodes/CreateFolderAction.php:9 and :68 dispatch FolderCreated.",
      "file": "docs/reference/events.md",
      "line": 96,
      "risk_class": "local",
      "scenario": "A host that follows the drive event reference and listens for Vaulter\\Drive\\Events\\StorageCreated or NodeCreated never sees Vaulter::for() provisioning or folder creation. Those live paths dispatch Vaulter\\Drive\\Events\\Drives\\DriveCreated and Vaulter\\Drive\\Events\\Nodes\\FolderCreated. The Russian reference repeats the same old names, so both catalogs subscribe consumers to the leftover event classes.",
      "severity": "major"
    },
    {
      "area": "DriveHandle profile contract",
      "evidence": "docs/guide/drive.md:87-89 annotates $drive->profile() as string; docs/ru/guide/drive.md:71 does the same; packages/core/src/Contracts/Drive/DriveHandle.php:26 and packages/drive/src/DriveHandle.php:64-67 return Profile from ProfileRegistry::get(); packages/core/src/Profiles/Profile.php:8-64 has getId() and no __toString; UPGRADE.md:69-74 documents the Profile return.",
      "file": "docs/guide/drive.md",
      "line": 89,
      "risk_class": "local",
      "scenario": "A caller who follows the drive guide treats $drive->profile() as a string. The core contract and DriveHandle::profile() return Vaulter\\Profiles\\Profile, which exposes getId() and has no __toString. Passing that value to a string parameter or interpolating it under the package's strict types raises TypeError. The Russian drive guide has the same annotation, while UPGRADE.md tells callers to use profile()->getId().",
      "severity": "major"
    },

  "findings": [

      "area": "drive FQN canon",
      "evidence": "packages/drive/src/DriveContext.php:40-65 implements Vaulter\\Contracts\\Drive\\DriveHandle with storage()/panel(); packages/core/src/Contracts/Drive/DriveHandle.php:24-26 requires model(): Drive and profile(): Profile; packages/drive/src/StorageManager.php:95 dispatches StorageCreated; packages/drive/src/DriveProvisioner.php:95 dispatches DriveCreated; packages/drive/src/Activity/RecordsDriveActivity.php:48 listens only for DriveCreated; UPGRADE.md:11-12 claims the old names are gone; both trees are present under packages/drive/src/{Actions,Data,Events,Exceptions,Http,Support/Uploads} and the new domain directories.",
      "file": "packages/drive/src/DriveContext.php",
      "line": 40,
      "risk_class": "local",
      "scenario": "Loading Vaulter\\Drive\\DriveContext is a fatal error: it implements Vaulter\\Contracts\\Drive\\DriveHandle but still declares storage(): Drive and panel(): string and does not declare the required model(): Drive or profile(): Profile. The 03 §4 renames were copied into the new namespaces and the old files were left autoloadable (DriveContext beside DriveHandle, StorageManager beside DriveProvisioner, Actions\\CreateFolderAction beside Actions\\Nodes\\CreateFolderAction, Events\\StorageCreated beside Events\\Drives\\DriveCreated, and the same fork for the other Actions, Data, Events, Exceptions, Http requests/resources/controllers, and Support\\Uploads\\StagedUpload/MagicByteSniffer). The required code-guidance scan is therefore not empty, and UPGRADE.md states that those old names have no aliases. Resolving the leftover StorageManager still dispatches StorageCreated from provision(), while the live DriveProvisioner path dispatches DriveCreated and RecordsDriveActivity/RecordsDriveOutbox listen only for DriveCreated, so that leftover provisioner writes neither an activity row nor an outbox row. In-repo callers still import the old types, including load/app/Console/PrepareMemoryFixturesCommand.php.",

    },
    {
      "area": "drive domain event catalog",

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Vaulter\Drive;
+
+use Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container;
+use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
+use Vaulter\Contracts\Drive\DriveHandle as DriveHandleContract;
+use Vaulter\Contracts\Drive\DriveHandleFactory as DriveHandleFactoryContract;
+use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Files\IngestFileAction;
+use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Nodes\CopyNodeAction;

+use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;
+
+/**
+ * The vaulter-drive implementation of the core {@see DriveHandleFactory} seam
+ * (P2 #5 / ADR-0015). It wires the DriveProvisioner, NodeReadRepository and the eight
+ * Drive Actions into a {@see DriveHandle}, so `Vaulter::for()` / `Vaulter::forStorage()`
+ * (defined in core's VaulterManager) return a working handle without core ever
+ * referencing a Drive class. Bound to the contract by VaulterDriveServiceProvider.
+ */
+final readonly class DriveHandleFactory implements DriveHandleFactoryContract
+{
+    public function __construct(
+        private Container $container,
+    ) {}
+
+    public function forOwner(Model $entity, string $panel): DriveHandleContract
+    {
+        $storage = $this->container->make(DriveProvisioner::class)->forOwner(owner: $entity, panel: $panel);
+
+        return $this->forStorage($storage);
+    }
+
+    public function forStorage(Drive $storage): DriveHandleContract
+    {
+        return new DriveHandle(
+            storage: $storage,
+            profiles: $this->container->make(ProfileRegistry::class),
+            storages: $this->container->make(DriveProvisioner::class),

sections.title: Vaulter — инструкции для агентов
sections.text:
Vaulter — PHP-монорепозиторий пакетов Laravel. Работай только в затронутом пакете
`packages/<name>/`; не меняй соседние пакеты и не перезаписывай чужие изменения.

Используй только нативно доступные навыки SKM: компактный marketplace-профиль задан в
`.swissknife.json` (как CoreX). Локальный `.agents/skills/` — только CORE (см.
`scripts/sync-agent-skills.sh`); не держи полный php-package vendor. Не загружай
справочники, планы или навыки «на всякий случай» — выбирай их по задаче.

MCP-серверы `maind`, `codegraph` и `perplexity` настроены для scope
`project:vaulter`. Проверяй состояние `maind health --cwd` при изменении среды или
симптомах, а не перед каждой обычной правкой.

Перед изменением кода прочитай ближайшие проектные инструкции и существующие тесты.
Проверяй затронутый пакет; не объявляй пропущенную или упавшую проверку успешной.
Пуш, публикация, удаление данных и перезапись несвязанных изменений требуют явного
запроса владельца.

sections.title: ADR-0017 — Internal package structure canon (layer-first + domain sub-namespace)
sections.text:
**Status:** accepted

> **Amendment (VLT-CANON P2.1).** The AzGuard bridge package was renamed
> `permissions-azgard` → **`azgard`** (`axioma-studio/vaulter-azgard`, namespace
> `Vaulter\Azgard\*`). This ADR's canon is unchanged — only the package's name is.
> Both mentions below are written in the current name.

sections.title: Context
sections.text:
vaulter is a monorepo of six PHP packages (`core`, `drive`, `media`, `documents`,
`filament`, `azgard`) over one shared kernel (ADR-0005 / ADR-0015).
Their internal `src/**` layout drifted into three incompatible schemes, which
breaks the layer-mirror navigation the monorepo depends on (VLT-REMED D10, owner
decision 2026-07-10):

1. **`vaulter-core` — layer-first + domain sub-namespace.** Technical layers
   (`Actions/`, `Models/`, `Repositories/`, `Enums/`, `Events/`, `Data/`,
   `Contracts/`, `Http/`, …) sit at the package root, and within each layer
   classes are grouped by a **domain** sub-namespace: `Actions/Sharing`,
   `Models/Drive`, `Enums/Webhooks`, `Http/Controllers/Access`. Cross-cutting
   domain services that do not fit a standard layer live in a top-level
   **domain-service folder** (`Access/`, `Sharing/`, `Webhooks/`, `Cas/`,
   `Activity/`). This is the reference scheme.
2. **`vaulter-drive` — domain-first island.** The `Uploads/` module carries its
   OWN nested layer tree (`Uploads/Actions`, `Uploads/Models`,
   `Uploads/Repositories`, `Uploads/Http`, `Uploads/Enums`, `Uploads/Data`,
   `Uploads/Contracts`) — the inverse of the core scheme (a layer nested UNDER a
   domain).
3. **`vaulter-documents` — flat layers.** Layers sit at the root (layer-first)
   but are **flat**: `Actions/` (9), `Events/` (6), `Data/` (6), `Enums/` (4),
   `Repositories/` (4), `Models/` (2) hold classes with no domain sub-namespace,
   plus a partly domain-first `Documents/` folder.

The full six-package inventory is in
`plans/archive/VLT-REMED/findings/P4.9-structure-inventory.md`.

This ADR **declares the canon**; it moves NO code. Enforcement is by Pest arch
tests added in the same change (VLT-REMED P4.9); the physical namespace refactor
that makes every package conform is a separate, reviewed step (VLT-REMED P4.10,
`php:namespace-refactor-safety`). Declaration and execution are split so the
canon is reviewed BEFORE the irreversible mass-move.

sections.title: Decision
sections.text:
**Canon A: layer-first placement + domain sub-namespace within layers.** The
reference is `vaulter-core`. Two structural laws, both machine-checked:

- **Law 1 — layer-first placement.** A recognized technical-layer directory
  (`Actions`, `Models`, `Repositories`, `Enums`, `Events`, `Data`, `Contracts`,
  `Http`) lives as the FIRST namespace segment under the package root
  (`Vaulter\<Pkg>\Actions\…`). A layer directory MUST NOT be nested inside a
  domain module folder (`src/Uploads/Actions` is a violation; `src/Actions/Uploads`
  is canonical). Sub-layers of `Http` (`Http/Controllers`, `Http/Requests`,
  `Http/Resources`, `Http/Middleware`, `Http/Support`) are structural, not
  domains, and are allowed.
- **Law 2 — domain sub-namespace within layers.** Inside a multi-domain layer,
  classes are grouped under a **domain** sub-namespace (`Actions/<Domain>/Class`),
  not placed flat directly in the layer root. A SHORT, explicit allow-list of
  cross-cutting root-citizens may stay flat at a layer root — currently
  `Contracts/IdStrategy` and `Exceptions/VaulterException` (the base exception).

**Allowed outside the two laws:**

- **Package entrypoints at `src/` root:** `*ServiceProvider`, `*Manager`,
  `*Context`, `*Plugin`, the facade seam, and a small models/config helper
  (`VaulterManager`, `DriveManager`, `DriveContext`, `StorageManager`,
  `DocumentsModels`, …).
- **Domain-service folders at `src/` root** for domain services/resolvers that do
  not belong to a standard layer — `core/src/{Access,Sharing,Webhooks,Cas,Activity}`
  is the reference shape. These are domain-named, NOT layer-named, so Law 1 does
  not apply to them.

**Target layers per package (the canonical set):** `Actions/`, `Models/`,
`Repositories/`, `Enums/`, `Events/`, `Data/`, `Contracts/`, `Http/` (with
`Controllers`/`Requests`/`Resources`/`Middleware`/`Support` sub-layers),
`Exceptions/`, `Jobs/`, `Policies/`, `Rules/`, `ValueObjects/`, `Console/`,
`Support/`, plus package-specific structural roots (`Drivers/`, `Schema/`,
`Panels/`, `Attributes/`, `Facades/`, `Testing/` in core).

**Exceptions (explicitly out of Canon A):**

- **`vaulter-filament`** follows the **Filament** plugin convention
  (`src/Resources/<XResource>/Pages/`), which is itself a canon owned by the
  framework. Canon A does NOT apply; P4.10 does not restructure it.
- **`vaulter-media`** and **`vaulter-azgard`** are minimal (a CAS
  domain-service folder / a guard adapter). They conform to Canon A in its narrow
  form; P4.10 only verifies them, it does not force a layer tree onto packages
  that have none.

**Enforcement (this change, P4.9):**

- `packages/core/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php` — Law 2 is already enforced green by
  the existing `split technical roots keep classes in domain subfolders` test;
  P4.9 adds an executable **Law 1 green-guard** tagged to this ADR.
- `packages/documents/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php` — a **Law 2** canon test, RED on
  the current flat layout, marked `->todo()` ("unblocked by P4.10 / ADR-0017").
- `packages/drive/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php` — a **Law 1** canon test, RED on the
  current `Uploads/*` layout, marked `->todo()` ("unblocked by P4.10 / ADR-0017").

The `->todo()` markers are the executable spec of the P4.10 scope: P4.10 makes
them pass by moving code, then removes the `->todo()`.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.text:
- The canon is an **executable specification**, not prose: a regression that
  drops a class back into a flat layer root (Law 2) or nests a layer under a
  domain (Law 1) trips an arch test naming the exact offender.
- `documents` and `drive` carry a KNOWN, encoded structural debt: their canon
  arch tests are red-in-principle (`->todo()`), so the debt is visible in the
  test report and cannot be silently forgotten. P4.10 discharges it.
- **Breaking change on execution (D3 — package unreleased, no BC obligation):**
  P4.10 changes public FQCNs (`Vaulter\Drive\Uploads\Actions\CommitUploadAction`
  → `Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Uploads\CommitUploadAction`, the documents flat
  classes gain a domain segment). Morph aliases, `config/vaulter.php` FQCN
  defaults, and docs references must move with the classes; recorded in
  `UPGRADE.md`. P4.9 itself changes NO code and breaks nothing.
- `filament` staying on the Filament convention is a deliberate, documented
  exception, not drift — future audits should not flag it against Canon A.

P2.7 — Canonical 0.3 schema and historical upgrade
sections.text:
Fresh canonical tables are created independently of module flags. All five affected
packages use drives, file_revisions and file_revision_blobs and the canonical persisted
attributes. The node head/document fields explicitly reserved for P4.1 stay historical.
Config::table is prefix + canonical name; legacyTable resolves only upgrade names.

Five new guarded migrations implement preflight, table/attribute/index/FK normalization,
revision changes, grants/shares cleanup and event/subscription conversion. P1 №3/№6/№7
use the actual ordered schema. D18 records owner-approved 72 historical + 2 root repair
activity entries and full upgrade-batch rollback rather than the invalid step=5.
Both bigint/ULID fixtures preserve expected data, owner IDs, revision numbers and scan
defaults, convert every historical event, replay each new up, rollback and re-upgrade.
Customized nodes/revision table names and historically disabled comments are checked.
Schema parity is exact, including PostgreSQL expressions/predicates and serial names;
the measured P2.1 baseline has zero differences for both strategies.

REST keys remain old until P6.1 while resources read new attributes. Removed storage
metadata returns null. UPGRADE explains backup, irreversible dropped metadata/grants,
share revocation, historical event maps, rollback and deferred node/document work.
API golden records EventType values, UpgradePreflightException and legacyTable.

sections.text:
**Intent:** Свежая установка создаёт таблицы и колонки в каноне OPUS 03 §7/08 §2 (в части P2) без feature-гейтов, а
база 0.2 (фикстура P0.3) доходит до той же схемы upgrade-миграциями №1, №2, №4, №8, №9 с сохранением данных; код всех
пакетов читает канонические таблицы/колонки, `EventType` получает канонические значения 03 §8 вместе с миграцией
сохранённых событий и подписок (D16, R7–R10).

**Why:** OPUS 13 P2.1 (миграции 2, 4, 8, 9 и preflight 1; V15 частично), 08 §2–§3, 03 §7–§8, 04 §2 («таблицы создаются
независимо от установленных модулей»), N28. Код `main` @ `938f0ea`: `PanelTablesBuilder.php:1249–1257` гейтит таблицы
флагами; `Support\Config::table()` (`Config.php:849`) применяет `vaulter.table_names`; `v_storages.panel`/`v_nodes.panel`
(`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1184`), `storage_id` в `nodes`/`blobs`/`upload_sessions`/`activity`; события хранятся строками в
`v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`, `v_webhook_endpoints.events` (строки 737, 799, 826, 848).

**Scope Included:**
1. Целевая схема в `Schema\SchemaBuilder` (fresh): сущности `drives` (было `storages`), `file_revisions`,
   `file_revision_blobs`; таблица `v_drives` по 08 §2: `profile` varchar(64) default `'default'` (было `panel`),
   `status` как сейчас (набор значений `active|archived|deleting` — P4.6), удалены `storage_type`, `slug`,
   `default_node_permissions`, `deleted_at`; индексы `UNIQUE(owner_type, owner_id, profile)`, `(profile, status)`, `(tenant_id)`; `v_nodes`: `drive_id` (было `storage_id`), `profile` (было
   `panel`, R17); `v_blobs.drive_id`; `v_files.current_revision_id`, `revision_count`, без `deleted_at`;
   `v_file_revisions`: `number` (было `version_no`), `sha256` (было `content_sha256`), `declared_mime_type varchar(191) null`,
   `scan_status varchar(16) not null default 'not_required'`, `UNIQUE(file_id, number)`; `v_file_revision_blobs.file_revision_id`;
   `v_node_grants` без `deleted_at`, `inherited`, `inherited_from_node_id`, обычный `UNIQUE(node_id, subject_type, subject_id, scope, effect)`
   (без MySQL `grant_active`); `v_node_shares` без `deleted_at`; `v_upload_sessions`: `drive_id`, `target_node_id` (было
   `node_id`), `result_node_id` REF null, `result_revision_id` REF null; `v_activity`: `drive_id`, `event_id varchar(26) null`
   (индекс); `v_outbox`: `drive_id` REF null, `aggregate_type varchar(32) null`, `aggregate_id varchar(64) null`,
   `sequence bigint null`. Имена индексов/FK, содержащие `storage`/`version`, получают `drive`/`revision`.
   Feature-гейты таблиц (`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1244–1260`) и проверка `extra_data` для таблиц удаляются: все таблицы
   создаются всегда (04 §2); `v_nodes.extra` остаётся под флагом `extra_data` до P4.1. Без изменений: `v_nodes.owner_id`,
   `current_version_id`, `file_id`, `deleted_at`, `v_node_document_versions` (P4.1).

   без feature-проверок (`000021`/`000022` больше не читают `featureEnabled`); `down()` — `dropTable`. Миграции P1
   `2026_10_01_000003/000006/000007` переходят на канонические ключи (`drives`, `file_revisions`, …, колонки `drive_id`).
3. `Support\Config`: `table(string $name)` = префикс + `$name` (без `table_names`); новый
   `legacyTable(string $legacyEntity): string` = префикс + (`vaulter.table_names.<legacyEntity>` или `$legacyEntity`) — только
   для upgrade-миграций (R9). Ключи `table_names` в `config/vaulter.php` остаются до P2.5.
4. `2026_10_01_000001_vaulter_preflight.php` (`up()` только проверяет; `down()` пустой): выполняется, если существует
   `legacyTable('storages')` и нет `table('drives')` (иначе no-op). Отказ `Vaulter\Exceptions\Schema\UpgradePreflightException`
   (new, extends `VaulterException`, код `upgrade_preflight_failed`) с перечнем найденного и подсказкой
   `php artisan vaulter:upgrade:inspect` (команда — P7), если: (a) `v_nodes.deleted_at IS NOT NULL` (кол-во);
   (b) узлы `kind = 'document'` без строк в `legacyTable('node_document_versions')` (или таблицы нет при наличии документов);
   (c) own-tables: таблица, имя которой оканчивается на `storages` и не равно `legacyTable('storages')` (`Schema::getTables()`);
   (d) `v_storages.deleted_at IS NOT NULL`; (e) `v_files.deleted_at IS NOT NULL` (R18: удаление колонок воскресило бы
   soft-deleted строки). Бэкап — требование `UPGRADE.md`; подтверждение — стандартный `migrate --force` в production (R18).
5. `…000002_rename_storages_to_drives.php` (каждый шаг проверяет состояние до выполнения):
   (a) каждая сущность из устаревшей `vaulter.table_names` с нестандартным именем → `RENAME` в `<prefix><сущность 0.2>`;
   (b) `storages` → `drives`; `panel` → `profile` в `v_drives` и `v_nodes`; `storage_id` → `drive_id` в `v_nodes`, `v_blobs`,
   `v_upload_sessions`, `v_activity`; переименование индексов/FK до имён `SchemaBuilder`;
   (c) удалить `v_drives.{storage_type, slug, default_node_permissions, deleted_at}` и зависимые индексы, создать индексы п.1;

   `down()`: обратные переименования; удалённые колонки возвращаются с дефолтами 0.2 (`storage_type 'private'`,

6. `…000004_file_revisions.php`: `file_versions` → `file_revisions` (`version_no` → `number`, `content_sha256` → `sha256`,
   + `declared_mime_type`, `scan_status` = `'not_required'` для существующих строк); `file_version_blobs` → `file_revision_blobs`

   PG — снять частичный unique, MySQL — `grant_active` и его unique; создать обычный unique п.1. `down()` возвращает
   колонки (`deleted_at null`, `inherited false`) и прежние уникальности; удалённые grants не восстанавливаются (UPGRADE.md).
8. `…000009_events.php` + значения `EventType` (R7, R10): карта `storage.created→drive.created`, `node.created→folder.created`,
   `version.created→file.revision_added`, `node.force_deleted→node.purged`, `upload_session.{initiated,aborted,expired}→upload.{…}`;
   `UPDATE` `v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`; `v_webhook_endpoints.events` — PHP-цикл
   чанками по 500 (JSON-список, порядок и дубликаты сохраняются); колонки п.1 для `v_activity`/`v_outbox`. `down()` —
   обратная карта и удаление колонок. В `EventType` значения case → канонические (`DriveCreated='drive.created'`, …).
9. Код всех пакетов: таблицы через `Config::table('<канон>')`, атрибуты/связи/запросы — канонические колонки
   (`storage_id`→`drive_id` в `src`/`tests`/factories, `version_no`→`number`, `content_sha256`→`sha256`,
   `current_version_id`→`current_revision_id` для `File`, `version_count`→`revision_count`, `file_version_id`→`file_revision_id`,
   `node_id`→`target_node_id` для `UploadSession`, `panel`→`profile`); `Profile::storageType()/storageTypeKey()` удаляются.
   HTTP-ответы и входы сохраняют прежние JSON-ключи (`storage_id`, `version_no`, …) до P6.1 (R19): ресурс отдаёт
   `'storage_id' => $this->drive_id`.
10. Тесты (`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/`, `uses(TestCase::class)` как у P1.7, PG; пропуск без pgsql или `psql`):
    - `Canon03UpgradeTest.php` — для `pgsql-bigint.sql` и `pgsql-ulid.sql`: загрузка (`LoadsV02Fixture`), `migrate --force` →
      успех; числа строк: `v_drives=3`, `v_nodes=40`, `v_files=16`, `v_file_revisions=22`, `v_file_revision_blobs=22`,
      `v_node_grants=3` (5 − 2 soft-deleted), `v_node_shares=4` (у soft-deleted `revoked_at = deleted_at`), `v_activity=72`,
      `v_outbox=68`, `v_webhook_deliveries=4`, `v_webhook_endpoints=1`; ни одного старого значения события в четырёх
      колонках п.8; `owner_id` строки `1,2,3`/три ULID README; `v_file_revisions.number` файла `q1.csv` = 1,2,3;
      `scan_status = 'not_required'` у всех; повторный `migrate` — no-op; `migrate:rollback --step=5` возвращает
      `v_storages` и прежние значения событий; повторный `migrate` снова зелёный.
    - `UpgradePreflightTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint-preflight-red.sql` → `migrate` падает с `UpgradePreflightException`, сообщение
      содержит `gone.txt`-счётчик, `Headless`, `vlegacy_storages`; таблицы не переименованы; случаи (d)/(e) — raw `UPDATE`
      поверх `pgsql-bigint.sql`.
    - `LegacyTableNamesUpgradeTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint.sql` + `ALTER TABLE v_nodes RENAME TO v_custom_nodes` и
      `vaulter.table_names.nodes = 'custom_nodes'` → после `migrate` существует `v_nodes`, строк 40.
    - `SchemaParityTest.php` — схема после upgrade каждого дампа = схема fresh `migrate` той же стратегии (колонки, типы,
      nullable, default, имена и столбцы индексов/unique/FK; порядок колонок не сравнивается). Расхождения, существовавшие

      затронутых колонках.

      `v_file_revisions`, `v_file_revision_blobs`, колонки п.1 и unique grants; нет `v_storages`, `grant_active`.

    `PublicApiSnapshotTest` (`EventType` значения, `UpgradePreflightException`, `Config::legacyTable`).

удаление `v_nodes.{current_version_id,file_id,deleted_at}` (P4.1, P4.7); `v_drives.status` (P4.6); заполнение

`packages/core/src/Exceptions/Schema/UpgradePreflightException.php` (new), `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_06_13_0000{07..22}_*.php`,

sections.title: P2.7 — Схема 0.3 и upgrade-миграции №1, №2, №4, №8, №9
sections.text:
**Intent:** Свежая установка создаёт таблицы и колонки в каноне OPUS 03 §7/08 §2 (в части P2) без feature-гейтов, а
база 0.2 (фикстура P0.3) доходит до той же схемы upgrade-миграциями №1, №2, №4, №8, №9 с сохранением данных; код всех
пакетов читает канонические таблицы/колонки, `EventType` получает канонические значения 03 §8 вместе с миграцией
сохранённых событий и подписок (D16, R7–R10).

**Why:** OPUS 13 P2.1 (миграции 2, 4, 8, 9 и preflight 1; V15 частично), 08 §2–§3, 03 §7–§8, 04 §2 («таблицы создаются
независимо от установленных модулей»), N28. Код `main` @ `938f0ea`: `PanelTablesBuilder.php:1249–1257` гейтит таблицы
флагами; `Support\Config::table()` (`Config.php:849`) применяет `vaulter.table_names`; `v_storages.panel`/`v_nodes.panel`
(`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1184`), `storage_id` в `nodes`/`blobs`/`upload_sessions`/`activity`; события хранятся строками в
`v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`, `v_webhook_endpoints.events` (строки 737, 799, 826, 848).

**Scope Included:**
1. Целевая схема в `Schema\SchemaBuilder` (fresh): сущности `drives` (было `storages`), `file_revisions`,
   `file_revision_blobs`; таблица `v_drives` по 08 §2: `profile` varchar(64) default `'default'` (было `panel`),
   `status` как сейчас (набор значений `active|archived|deleting` — P4.6), удалены `storage_type`, `slug`,
   `default_node_permissions`, `deleted_at`; индексы `UNIQUE(owner_type, owner_id, profile)`, `(profile, status)`, `(tenant_id)`; `v_nodes`: `drive_id` (было `storage_id`), `profile` (было
   `panel`, R17); `v_blobs.drive_id`; `v_files.current_revision_id`, `revision_count`, без `deleted_at`;
   `v_file_revisions`: `number` (было `version_no`), `sha256` (было `content_sha256`), `declared_mime_type varchar(191) null`,
   `scan_status varchar(16) not null default 'not_required'`, `UNIQUE(file_id, number)`; `v_file_revision_blobs.file_revision_id`;
   `v_node_grants` без `deleted_at`, `inherited`, `inherited_from_node_id`, обычный `UNIQUE(node_id, subject_type, subject_id, scope, effect)`
   (без MySQL `grant_active`); `v_node_shares` без `deleted_at`; `v_upload_sessions`: `drive_id`, `target_node_id` (было
   `node_id`), `result_node_id` REF null, `result_revision_id` REF null; `v_activity`: `drive_id`, `event_id varchar(26) null`
   (индекс); `v_outbox`: `drive_id` REF null, `aggregate_type varchar(32) null`, `aggregate_id varchar(64) null`,
   `sequence bigint null`. Имена индексов/FK, содержащие `storage`/`version`, получают `drive`/`revision`.
   Feature-гейты таблиц (`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1244–1260`) и проверка `extra_data` для таблиц удаляются: все таблицы
   создаются всегда (04 §2); `v_nodes.extra` остаётся под флагом `extra_data` до P4.1. Без изменений: `v_nodes.owner_id`,
   `current_version_id`, `file_id`, `deleted_at`, `v_node_document_versions` (P4.1).
2. Базовые миграции (R8): `2026_06_13_000007…000022` не переименовываются; `up()` → `(new SchemaBuilder)->createTable('<канон>')`
   без feature-проверок (`000021`/`000022` больше не читают `featureEnabled`); `down()` — `dropTable`. Миграции P1
   `2026_10_01_000003/000006/000007` переходят на канонические ключи (`drives`, `file_revisions`, …, колонки `drive_id`).
3. `Support\Config`: `table(string $name)` = префикс + `$name` (без `table_names`); новый
   `legacyTable(string $legacyEntity): string` = префикс + (`vaulter.table_names.<legacyEntity>` или `$legacyEntity`) — только
   для upgrade-миграций (R9). Ключи `table_names` в `config/vaulter.php` остаются до P2.5.
4. `2026_10_01_000001_vaulter_preflight.php` (`up()` только проверяет; `down()` пустой): выполняется, если существует
   `legacyTable('storages')` и нет `table('drives')` (иначе no-op). Отказ `Vaulter\Exceptions\Schema\UpgradePreflightException`
   (new, extends `VaulterException`, код `upgrade_preflight_failed`) с перечнем найденного и подсказкой
   `php artisan vaulter:upgrade:inspect` (команда — P7), если: (a) `v_nodes.deleted_at IS NOT NULL` (кол-во);
   (b) узлы `kind = 'document'` без строк в `legacyTable('node_document_versions')` (или таблицы нет при наличии документов);
   (c) own-tables: таблица, имя которой оканчивается на `storages` и не равно `legacyTable('storages')` (`Schema::getTables()`);
   (d) `v_storages.deleted_at IS NOT NULL`; (e) `v_files.deleted_at IS NOT NULL` (R18: удаление колонок воскресило бы
   soft-deleted строки). Бэкап — требование `UPGRADE.md`; подтверждение — стандартный `migrate --force` в production (R18).
5. `…000002_rename_storages_to_drives.php` (каждый шаг проверяет состояние до выполнения):
   (a) каждая сущность из устаревшей `vaulter.table_names` с нестандартным именем → `RENAME` в `<prefix><сущность 0.2>`;
   (b) `storages` → `drives`; `panel` → `profile` в `v_drives` и `v_nodes`; `storage_id` → `drive_id` в `v_nodes`, `v_blobs`,
   `v_upload_sessions`, `v_activity`; переименование индексов/FK до имён `SchemaBuilder`;
   (c) удалить `v_drives.{storage_type, slug, default_node_permissions, deleted_at}` и зависимые индексы, создать индексы п.1;
   (d) создать отсутствующие таблицы ядра (ранее выключенные флагами 0.2) через `SchemaBuilder::createTable()`.
   `down()`: обратные переименования; удалённые колонки возвращаются с дефолтами 0.2 (`storage_type 'private'`,
   `slug null`, `default_node_permissions 31`, `deleted_at null`) — значения потеряны (UPGRADE.md); таблицы шага (d) не удаляются.
6. `…000004_file_revisions.php`: `file_versions` → `file_revisions` (`version_no` → `number`, `content_sha256` → `sha256`,
   + `declared_mime_type`, `scan_status` = `'not_required'` для существующих строк); `file_version_blobs` → `file_revision_blobs`
   (`file_version_id` → `file_revision_id`, PK/FK); `v_files`: `current_version_id` → `current_revision_id`,
   `version_count` → `revision_count`, удалить `deleted_at`; `v_upload_sessions`: `node_id` → `target_node_id`,
   + `result_node_id`, `result_revision_id` (тип REF по `ids.default`). `down()` — обратно.
7. `…000008_grants_shares_cleanup.php`: `DELETE` grants с `deleted_at IS NOT NULL`; shares:
   `revoked_at = COALESCE(revoked_at, deleted_at)`; удалить `deleted_at` (оба), `inherited`, `inherited_from_node_id`;
   PG — снять частичный unique, MySQL — `grant_active` и его unique; создать обычный unique п.1. `down()` возвращает
   колонки (`deleted_at null`, `inherited false`) и прежние уникальности; удалённые grants не восстанавливаются (UPGRADE.md).
8. `…000009_events.php` + значения `EventType` (R7, R10): карта `storage.created→drive.created`, `node.created→folder.created`,
   `version.created→file.revision_added`, `node.force_deleted→node.purged`, `upload_session.{initiated,aborted,expired}→upload.{…}`;
   `UPDATE` `v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`; `v_webhook_endpoints.events` — PHP-цикл
   чанками по 500 (JSON-список, порядок и дубликаты сохраняются); колонки п.1 для `v_activity`/`v_outbox`. `down()` —
   обратная карта и удаление колонок. В `EventType` значения case → канонические (`DriveCreated='drive.created'`, …).
9. Код всех пакетов: таблицы через `Config::table('<канон>')`, атрибуты/связи/запросы — канонические колонки
   (`storage_id`→`drive_id` в `src`/`tests`/factories, `version_no`→`number`, `content_sha256`→`sha256`,
   `current_version_id`→`current_revision_id` для `File`, `version_count`→`revision_count`, `file_version_id`→`file_revision_id`,
   `node_id`→`target_node_id` для `UploadSession`, `panel`→`profile`); `Profile::storageType()/storageTypeKey()` удаляются.
   HTTP-ответы и входы сохраняют прежние JSON-ключи (`storage_id`, `version_no`, …) до P6.1 (R19): ресурс отдаёт
   `'storage_id' => $this->drive_id`.
10. Тесты (`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/`, `uses(TestCase::class)` как у P1.7, PG; пропуск без pgsql или `psql`):
    - `Canon03UpgradeTest.php` — для `pgsql-bigint.sql` и `pgsql-ulid.sql`: загрузка (`LoadsV02Fixture`), `migrate --force` →
      успех; числа строк: `v_drives=3`, `v_nodes=40`, `v_files=16`, `v_file_revisions=22`, `v_file_revision_blobs=22`,
      `v_node_grants=3` (5 − 2 soft-deleted), `v_node_shares=4` (у soft-deleted `revoked_at = deleted_at`), `v_activity=72`,
      `v_outbox=68`, `v_webhook_deliveries=4`, `v_webhook_endpoints=1`; ни одного старого значения события в четырёх
      колонках п.8; `owner_id` строки `1,2,3`/три ULID README; `v_file_revisions.number` файла `q1.csv` = 1,2,3;
      `scan_status = 'not_required'` у всех; повторный `migrate` — no-op; `migrate:rollback --step=5` возвращает
      `v_storages` и прежние значения событий; повторный `migrate` снова зелёный.
    - `UpgradePreflightTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint-preflight-red.sql` → `migrate` падает с `UpgradePreflightException`, сообщение
      содержит `gone.txt`-счётчик, `Headless`, `vlegacy_storages`; таблицы не переименованы; случаи (d)/(e) — raw `UPDATE`
      поверх `pgsql-bigint.sql`.
    - `LegacyTableNamesUpgradeTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint.sql` + `ALTER TABLE v_nodes RENAME TO v_custom_nodes` и
      `vaulter.table_names.nodes = 'custom_nodes'` → после `migrate` существует `v_nodes`, строк 40.
    - `SchemaParityTest.php` — схема после upgrade каждого дампа = схема fresh `migrate` той же стратегии (колонки, типы,
      nullable, default, имена и столбцы индексов/unique/FK; порядок колонок не сравнивается). Расхождения, существовавшие
      до P2.7 (замер на дереве P2.1), — `artifacts/P2.7/parity-baseline.txt`; P2.7 не добавляет новых и устраняет все на
      затронутых колонках.
    - Fresh на MySQL: `packages/core/tests/Schema/CanonicalSchemaTest.php` — после `migrate` существуют `v_drives`,
      `v_file_revisions`, `v_file_revision_blobs`, колонки п.1 и unique grants; нет `v_storages`, `grant_active`.
11. Документация: `UPGRADE.md` (миграции №1, №2, №4, №8, №9, необратимые шаги, бэкап, карта событий для подписчиков
    webhooks), `CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]`, `docs/guide/{database-compatibility,configuration,webhooks}.md`; golden
    `PublicApiSnapshotTest` (`EventType` значения, `UpgradePreflightException`, `Config::legacyTable`).

**Scope Excluded:** миграции №5, №6 (кроме ссылок п.2), `v_documents`, `v_document_revisions`, `owned_by`, `sequence`,
удаление `v_nodes.{current_version_id,file_id,deleted_at}` (P4.1, P4.7); `v_drives.status` (P4.6); заполнение
`declared_mime_type`/`scan_status` (P3.7), outbox-колонок (P5.1); новые типы событий (P5.2); JSON-ключи REST (P6.1);
`vaulter:upgrade:inspect`, doctor, `drives:recount` (P7); MySQL-upgrade 0.2 (данных 0.2 на MySQL нет — D09).

`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/LoadsV02Fixture.php` (producer: P1.7).

**Files:** `packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php`, `packages/core/src/Support/Config.php`, `packages/core/src/Enums/Events/EventType.php`,
`packages/core/src/Exceptions/Schema/UpgradePreflightException.php` (new), `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_06_13_0000{07..22}_*.php`,
`packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_00000{1,2,4,8,9}_*.php` (new), `…_000003/000006/000007_*.php`,
`packages/{core,drive,documents,media,filament}/{src,tests,database}/**` (имена таблиц/колонок, значения событий),

**Required Reads:** 0) `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-P2-design-P2.7-opus.json` (дословные требования OPUS — исполнить все,
кроме переданных по `note` ledger); 1) `packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php` (producer: P2.1; `defineStorages`…`defineWebhookDeliveries`,
уникальности 1020–1130, гейты 1240–1260); 2) `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000006_nodes_cleanup.php` (стиль
идемпотентной миграции P1); 3) `packages/core/tests/Upgrade/LoadsV02Fixture.php`; 4) `tests/fixtures/v0.2.0/README.md`;
5) `packages/core/src/Support/Config.php` (840–860); 6) `packages/core/src/Enums/Events/EventType.php` (producer: P2.1).

**Authority:** routine

**Implementation Rules:**
- Каждый шаг миграции проверяет состояние (`Schema::hasTable/hasColumn`, `getIndexes`, `getForeignKeys`) до выполнения;
  повтор после падения посередине доходит до конца (MySQL DDL не транзакционен).

  значения, а данные — старые.

- Если `SchemaParityTest` показывает расхождение вне `parity-baseline.txt`, которое нельзя устранить без изменения
  шага OPUS, — стоп и эскалация.

**Code Guidance:** остатки в коде (ожидаемый вывод пуст):
`grep -rnE "'storage_id'|->storage_id|'version_no'|'content_sha256'|'file_version_id'|'current_version_id'|'version_count'|Config::table\('(storages|file_versions|file_version_blobs)'\)|table_names" packages/*/src packages/*/database | grep -v "Support/Config.php" | grep -v "Http/Resources" | grep -v "Models/Drive/Node.php"`

совпадению на файл, перечисленному в Completion Notes).

  подписке); (2) убрать проверку (a) из preflight → `UpgradePreflightTest` красный; вернуть оба.

sections.title: P2.7 — Схема 0.3 и upgrade-миграции №1, №2, №4, №8, №9
sections.text:
**Intent:** Свежая установка создаёт таблицы и колонки в каноне OPUS 03 §7/08 §2 (в части P2) без feature-гейтов, а
база 0.2 (фикстура P0.3) доходит до той же схемы upgrade-миграциями №1, №2, №4, №8, №9 с сохранением данных; код всех
пакетов читает канонические таблицы/колонки, `EventType` получает канонические значения 03 §8 вместе с миграцией
сохранённых событий и подписок (D16, R7–R10).

**Why:** OPUS 13 P2.1 (миграции 2, 4, 8, 9 и preflight 1; V15 частично), 08 §2–§3, 03 §7–§8, 04 §2 («таблицы создаются
независимо от установленных модулей»), N28. Код `main` @ `938f0ea`: `PanelTablesBuilder.php:1249–1257` гейтит таблицы
флагами; `Support\Config::table()` (`Config.php:849`) применяет `vaulter.table_names`; `v_storages.panel`/`v_nodes.panel`
(`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1184`), `storage_id` в `nodes`/`blobs`/`upload_sessions`/`activity`; события хранятся строками в
`v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`, `v_webhook_endpoints.events` (строки 737, 799, 826, 848).

**Scope Included:**
1. Целевая схема в `Schema\SchemaBuilder` (fresh): сущности `drives` (было `storages`), `file_revisions`,
   `file_revision_blobs`; таблица `v_drives` по 08 §2: `profile` varchar(64) default `'default'` (было `panel`),
   `status` как сейчас (набор значений `active|archived|deleting` — P4.6), удалены `storage_type`, `slug`,
   `default_node_permissions`, `deleted_at`; индексы `UNIQUE(owner_type, owner_id, profile)`, `(profile, status)`, `(tenant_id)`; `v_nodes`: `drive_id` (было `storage_id`), `profile` (было
   `panel`, R17); `v_blobs.drive_id`; `v_files.current_revision_id`, `revision_count`, без `deleted_at`;
   `v_file_revisions`: `number` (было `version_no`), `sha256` (было `content_sha256`), `declared_mime_type varchar(191) null`,
   `scan_status varchar(16) not null default 'not_required'`, `UNIQUE(file_id, number)`; `v_file_revision_blobs.file_revision_id`;
   `v_node_grants` без `deleted_at`, `inherited`, `inherited_from_node_id`, обычный `UNIQUE(node_id, subject_type, subject_id, scope, effect)`
   (без MySQL `grant_active`); `v_node_shares` без `deleted_at`; `v_upload_sessions`: `drive_id`, `target_node_id` (было
   `node_id`), `result_node_id` REF null, `result_revision_id` REF null; `v_activity`: `drive_id`, `event_id varchar(26) null`
   (индекс); `v_outbox`: `drive_id` REF null, `aggregate_type varchar(32) null`, `aggregate_id varchar(64) null`,
   `sequence bigint null`. Имена индексов/FK, содержащие `storage`/`version`, получают `drive`/`revision`.
   Feature-гейты таблиц (`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1244–1260`) и проверка `extra_data` для таблиц удаляются: все таблицы
   создаются всегда (04 §2); `v_nodes.extra` остаётся под флагом `extra_data` до P4.1. Без изменений: `v_nodes.owner_id`,
   `current_version_id`, `file_id`, `deleted_at`, `v_node_document_versions` (P4.1).
2. Базовые миграции (R8): `2026_06_13_000007…000022` не переименовываются; `up()` → `(new SchemaBuilder)->createTable('<канон>')`
   без feature-проверок (`000021`/`000022` больше не читают `featureEnabled`); `down()` — `dropTable`. Миграции P1
   `2026_10_01_000003/000006/000007` переходят на канонические ключи (`drives`, `file_revisions`, …, колонки `drive_id`).
3. `Support\Config`: `table(string $name)` = префикс + `$name` (без `table_names`); новый
   `legacyTable(string $legacyEntity): string` = префикс + (`vaulter.table_names.<legacyEntity>` или `$legacyEntity`) — только
   для upgrade-миграций (R9). Ключи `table_names` в `config/vaulter.php` остаются до P2.5.
4. `2026_10_01_000001_vaulter_preflight.php` (`up()` только проверяет; `down()` пустой): выполняется, если существует
   `legacyTable('storages')` и нет `table('drives')` (иначе no-op). Отказ `Vaulter\Exceptions\Schema\UpgradePreflightException`
   (new, extends `VaulterException`, код `upgrade_preflight_failed`) с перечнем найденного и подсказкой
   `php artisan vaulter:upgrade:inspect` (команда — P7), если: (a) `v_nodes.deleted_at IS NOT NULL` (кол-во);
   (b) узлы `kind = 'document'` без строк в `legacyTable('node_document_versions')` (или таблицы нет при наличии документов);

5. `…000002_rename_storages_to_drives.php` (каждый шаг проверяет состояние до выполнения):
   (a) каждая сущность из устаревшей `vaulter.table_names` с нестандартным именем → `RENAME` в `<prefix><сущность 0.2>`;

   `v_upload_sessions`, `v_activity`; переименование индексов/FK до имён `SchemaBuilder`;

6. `…000004_file_revisions.php`: `file_versions` → `file_revisions` (`version_no` → `number`, `content_sha256` → `sha256`,

7. `…000008_grants_shares_cleanup.php`: `DELETE` grants с `deleted_at IS NOT NULL`; shares:
   `revoked_at = COALESCE(revoked_at, deleted_at)`; удалить `deleted_at` (оба), `inherited`, `inherited_from_node_id`;

   `version.created→file.revision_added`, `node.force_deleted→node.purged`, `upload_session.{initiated,aborted,expired}→upload.{…}`;
   `UPDATE` `v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`; `v_webhook_endpoints.events` — PHP-цикл
   чанками по 500 (JSON-список, порядок и дубликаты сохраняются); колонки п.1 для `v_activity`/`v_outbox`. `down()` —
   обратная карта и удаление колонок. В `EventType` значения case → канонические (`DriveCreated='drive.created'`, …).

   (`storage_id`→`drive_id` в `src`/`tests`/factories, `version_no`→`number`, `content_sha256`→`sha256`,
   `current_version_id`→`current_revision_id` для `File`, `version_count`→`revision_count`, `file_version_id`→`file_revision_id`,
   `node_id`→`target_node_id` для `UploadSession`, `panel`→`profile`); `Profile::storageType()/storageTypeKey()` удаляются.

    - `Canon03UpgradeTest.php` — для `pgsql-bigint.sql` и `pgsql-ulid.sql`: загрузка (`LoadsV02Fixture`), `migrate --force` →
      успех; числа строк: `v_drives=3`, `v_nodes=40`, `v_files=16`, `v_file_revisions=22`, `v_file_revision_blobs=22`,

      `v_outbox=68`, `v_webhook_deliveries=4`, `v_webhook_endpoints=1`; ни одного старого значения события в четырёх
      колонках п.8; `owner_id` строки `1,2,3`/три ULID README; `v_file_revisions.number` файла `q1.csv` = 1,2,3;
      `scan_status = 'not_required'` у всех; повторный `migrate` — no-op; `migrate:rollback --step=5` возвращает
      `v_storages` и прежние значения событий; повторный `migrate` снова зелёный.
    - `UpgradePreflightTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint-preflight-red.sql` → `migrate` падает с `UpgradePreflightException`, сообщение
      содержит `gone.txt`-счётчик, `Headless`, `vlegacy_storages`; таблицы не переименованы; случаи (d)/(e) — raw `UPDATE`
      поверх `pgsql-bigint.sql`.
    - `LegacyTableNamesUpgradeTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint.sql` + `ALTER TABLE v_nodes RENAME TO v_custom_nodes` и

      nullable, default, имена и столбцы индексов/unique/FK; порядок колонок не сравнивается). Расхождения, существовавшие

`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/LoadsV02Fixture.php` (producer: P1.7).

`packages/core/src/Exceptions/Schema/UpgradePreflightException.php` (new), `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_06_13_0000{07..22}_*.php`,
`packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_00000{1,2,4,8,9}_*.php` (new), `…_000003/000006/000007_*.php`,

sections.text:

This is the initial completed review: there are no previous findings to locate.

The PostgreSQL P1 regression grid is complete: 477 passed in total, zero failures;
the full supplemental Media CAS command skips four explicitly SQLite-premise cases.
Those four cases execute in the green complete SQLite Media gate. Every PostgreSQL
acceptance case executes. postgresql-applicability.json identifies the raw counts
and each conditional case rather than falsely reporting raw zero skips. Review the entire code/schema delta and
dependency closure; do not invent a product finding merely for the disclosed pending
regression gate. No phase audit is requested.
